raw.excerpt: At Fusion Connect, we’re not just offering jobs — we’re building careers that empower, inspire, and grow with you.
raw.description:
At Fusion Connect, we’re not just offering jobs — we’re building careers that empower, inspire, and grow with you.

If you're passionate about making an impact, collaborating with forward-thinking teams, and being part of a company that values your voice, you’re in the right place.

We’re thrilled you’re exploring this opportunity with us — take a look, imagine the possibilities, and let’s shape the future of connectivity together.

Job Description Summary:

Fusion Connect is seeking a collaborative and highly organized Sales Enablement Specialist - Partner & Sales Training to support the development, onboarding, and ongoing enablement of our internal Sales and Customer Experience teams and external partner community. This role will have primary responsibility for administering and coordinating the partner onboarding experience, ensuring new partners have the knowledge, tools, resources, and training needed to effectively position and sell Fusion Connect solutions.

The Sales Enablement Specialist will also serve as a sales trainer and facilitator, delivering product, solution, sales skills, process, and go-to-market training across Fusion Connect's Sales and Customer Experience organizations and partner ecosystem. Working closely with Product, Product Marketing, Sales, CX, Channel, and other subject-matter experts, this individual will help identify training needs, translate complex product and business information into practical learning experiences, and develop or enhance training content and enablement resources.

The ideal candidate is an engaging facilitator, strong communicator, and organized program administrator who is comfortable learning technical concepts and translating them into clear, actionable content for sellers and customer-facing teams.

Job Description:

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following (other duties may be assigned):

Partner Onboarding & Enablement

  • Own the administration and coordination of the partner onboarding program, providing a consistent and effective onboarding experience for new Fusion Connect partners.
  • Coordinate onboarding activities, training schedules, required resources, system and portal education, and other enablement activities necessary to prepare partners to sell Fusion Connect solutions.
  • Serve as a primary enablement point of contact throughout the partner onboarding process, working closely with Channel Managers and other internal stakeholders.
  • Track partner onboarding progress, participation, completion, and readiness and identify opportunities to improve the onboarding experience.
  • Maintain partner onboarding materials, learning paths, checklists, job aids, and supporting resources.
  • Deliver ongoing partner education following initial onboarding, including product updates, new solution launches, sales skills, tools, processes, and go-to-market initiatives.
  • Gather feedback from partners and Channel Managers to continuously improve partner onboarding and enablement programs.

Sales & CX Training

  • Facilitate engaging instructor-led and virtual training for internal Sales, Customer Experience, and other customer-facing teams.
  • Deliver training across topics including product and solution knowledge, sales methodology and skills, competitive positioning, sales tools, processes, systems, and go-to-market initiatives.
  • Adapt training delivery based on audience needs, including new hires, experienced sellers, CX professionals, Channel Managers, and external partners.
  • Reinforce learning through follow-up sessions, coaching resources, job aids, knowledge checks, and other enablement activities.
  • Support internal new-hire sales onboarding and ongoing learning programs as needed.
  • Partner with Sales and CX leadership to identify skill gaps and determine where training or enablement can improve seller effectiveness and customer outcomes.

Product Training & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Establish a strong working partnership with the Product organization to understand upcoming product launches, enhancements, changes, and strategic priorities.
  • Work with Product and other subject-matter experts to identify the knowledge and skills Sales, CX, and Partners need to successfully position, sell, support, and discuss Fusion Connect solutions.
  • Translate product information and technical concepts into practical, seller-friendly training and enablement.
  • Coordinate and deliver training associated with new product launches, product updates, and changes to Fusion Connect's solution portfolio.
  • Help ensure training is delivered to the appropriate audiences at the appropriate point in the product launch and go-to-market process.
  • Gather feedback from Sales, CX, and Partners regarding product knowledge gaps and communicate those needs back to Product and Enablement leadership.

Training Content & Instructional Design

  • Develop and maintain training materials in partnership with subject-matter experts, including presentations, facilitator guides, participant materials, job aids, reference guides, knowledge checks, and e-learning content where appropriate.
  • Apply basic instructional design and adult-learning principles to make training practical, engaging, and relevant to the learner.
  • Convert complex product, process, and sales information into clear learning objectives and easy-to-understand training content.
  • Refresh existing training materials as products, processes, tools, and go-to-market strategies evolve.
  • Maintain an organized library of current training and enablement resources.
  • Support the development of scalable learning programs that combine instructor-led training, self-directed learning, reinforcement, and practical application.

Enablement Program Support

  • Collaborate with Sales, CX, Channel, Product, Marketing, Operations, and other teams to identify and prioritize enablement needs.
  • Support sales enablement initiatives including product launches, sales plays, competitive positioning, sales process changes, and other strategic programs.
  • Track training participation, completion, learner feedback, and other measures to help evaluate training effectiveness.
  • Recommend improvements to training programs based on learner feedback, business needs, and observed performance gaps.
  • Support administration of sales enablement and learning platforms as appropriate.
  • Take on additional training and enablement initiatives as business needs evolve.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Requirements:

  • Experience in sales enablement, sales training, partner/channel enablement, learning and development, or a related field.
  • Strong presentation and facilitation skills with the ability to engage both virtual and in-person audiences.
  • Ability to translate technical or complex information into clear, practical training for sales and customer-facing audiences.
  • Strong written communication and content-development skills.
  • Working knowledge of instructional design and adult-learning principles.
  • Ability to develop effective training materials including presentations, facilitator guides, job aids, reference materials, and knowledge checks.
  • Strong organizational and project-management skills with the ability to coordinate multiple onboarding and training initiatives simultaneously.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, CX, Channel, Marketing, and Operations teams.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and confidence working with both internal employees and external partners.
  • Ability to learn new products, technologies, processes, and systems quickly.
  • Experience administering onboarding, training, or learning programs strongly preferred.
  • Ability to work independently while effectively managing multiple priorities and deadlines.

Education and/or Experience Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or GED required; Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, Education, Instructional Design, Learning & Development, or a related discipline preferred.
  • Three (3) or more years of experience in sales enablement, sales training, partner enablement, learning and development, or a related customer-facing enablement role preferred.
  • Experience delivering instructor-led and virtual training strongly preferred.
  • Experience developing training or enablement content preferred.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, learning management systems, partner portals, content management systems, and/or sales enablement platforms preferred.
  • Telecommunications, technology, SaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, networking, or related industry experience is a plus.

raw.description:
Continental Propertiesis looking for a Centralized Leasing and Admin Specialist to join our Operations team.

As the Centralized Leasing and Admin Specialist, you will play a critical role in enhancing the customer experience and ensuring application accuracy by supporting the administrative and documentation process for new applicants. You will support our onsite community teams and elevate the overall prospect to resident experience, helping ensure customers move through the leasing journey smoothly, accurately, and confidently. This includes reviewing applicant documents, confirming data accuracy, identifying potential fraud, and communicating with customers to ensure all required information is submitted. Your work directly contributes to stronger compliance, faster decision making, and greater consistency across our communities.

If you excel in organization, communication, and problem solving—and enjoy supporting both customers and onsite teams—this is an excellent opportunity to make an impact.

This position can work remote within any of our core markets (CO, MN, IL, WI, GA, FL, MI, AZ). Candidates must reside within one hour of a Continental community as this role will require periodic visits to supported communities and visits to our home office in Menomonee, WI.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Proactively manage outbound and inbound communication (phone, email, text) with applicants to gather required documentation within 48 hours of application completion.
  • Thoroughly review and verify credit reports, income documents, and identification materials to ensure accuracy, completeness, and alignment with company standards.
  • Verify the accuracy of applicant demographics and follow up with applicants to obtain missing or corrected information as needed.
  • Monitor, track, and communicate documentation trends, accuracy patterns, and process gaps to Operations Leadership to support ongoing improvement.
  • Partner closely with Community Managers to provide timely application updates and clearly outline next steps to ensure 100% document completion prior to approval.
  • Perform additional responsibilities and support tasks assigned to meet business and operational needs.

Skills for Success:

  • Associate’s Degree required or equivalent experience
  • One (1) or more years of apartment leasing experience preferred
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfortable navigating multiple systems and conducting system audits for accuracy and compliance
  • Strong organization and time‑management to manage high volumes of applications and documentation deadlines
  • Experience with Property Management Systems (PMS), particularly OneSite, strongly preferred
  • Proficiency in Spanish is a plus

Why You'll Love Life at Continental:

Our award-winning culture fosters innovation and empowers our team members to lead. Here are some of the reasons that our team members continue to vote for us as a Top Workplace:

  • Career Growth: You'll have the tools, training, and opportunities for a meaningful career with long-term growth potential. We invest in your learning & development with paid professional memberships, certifications, and tuition reimbursement.

  • Mental Health & Wellness: Your well-being matters. We provide comprehensive mental health support including but not limited to 8-free counseling sessions per year and access to additional wellness resources.

  • Balance: We recognize that balance varies for everyone, and we support our team members with that in mind. Recharge with generous vacation time, 9-paid holidays, and half-days on Fridays during designated months.

  • Community & Connection: Build relationships through informal gatherings, lunches, community and company events, volunteer opportunities, and a vibrant social culture. Learn more about recent Continental events here!

  • Culture of Belonging: The Continental IDEA (Inclusion, Diversity, Equity, & Allies) is our commitment to evolving our culture where team members feel a sense of belongingness each day. Our You Belong Here Initiative and Business Resource Groups focus on fostering an inclusive and equitable work environment for all.

  • Performance Incentives: Participate in our Building Above and Beyond (BAAB) incentive program that rewards team members annually based on company goals and achievements.

  • Industry-Leading Benefits: Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including Medical, Dental, and Vision Plans, flexible spending accounts, 401(k) with company match, and company-paid life and disability insurance.

  • Family Support: Support your growing family with 6-weeks paid parental leave and with family-forming & fertility resources (up to 12-weeks leave for birth mothers).


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

We comply with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), and all applicable state and local fair employment practices laws, and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with disabilities.

For the benefit of our residents, the communities we serve, and our co-workers, all applicants are required to pass a post-offer criminal background check prior to joining the Continental team.

We are committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The posted salary range represents our good faith estimate of the base salary for this role at the time of posting. Final compensation is based on a variety of factors, including a candidate’s experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity. This range does not include bonus potential or other forms of compensation and benefits.

Pay Range: $57,000 - $68,000

Job Description:

Web Developer – .NET, Blazor and Azure - C-SAM UK

C-SAM develops specialist asset management, rental, service, certification and operational software for customers operating across the UK and international markets.
We are currently investing heavily in the development of our next-generation web application framework. This framework will modernise our established Windows-based software and provide a scalable, secure and configurable cloud platform for both existing and new customers.
We are looking for a practical and experienced Web Developer to join our development team and help build, improve and deliver this new platform.

The Web Developer will work primarily on C-SAM’s newest web application framework, developing reusable components, customer-facing modules, integrations and core platform functionality.
You will work across the full development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment and ongoing improvement.
The role will also involve understanding and, where required, migrating functionality from our existing VB.NET, WinForms and SQL Server applications into the new web platform.
This is a hands-on development role suited to someone who enjoys solving real business problems, working with complex workflows and building software that is reliable, maintainable and easy for users to operate.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain functionality within C-SAM’s new .NET web application framework.
• Build reusable Blazor components, shared services and configurable application modules.
• Develop responsive and user-friendly web interfaces.
• Convert existing Windows application functionality into modern web-based workflows.
• Work with product owners, operational teams and customers to understand business requirements.
• Design and implement secure, scalable and maintainable solutions.
• Develop and optimise Entity Framework queries and data access services.
• Create and maintain SQL Server stored procedures, views, functions and scripts.
• Improve application and database performance.
• Build integrations with customer systems, third-party APIs and cloud services.
• Assist with data migration, cleansing and validation activities.
• Develop authentication, role-based access and permission functionality.
• Support multi-company, multi-entity and multi-customer application structures.
• Write unit tests and assist with integration, regression and user acceptance testing.
• Diagnose and resolve software defects and performance issues.
• Review code and contribute to development standards and architecture decisions.
• Produce clear technical documentation and implementation notes.
• Support application deployments to Azure environments.
• Work with AI-assisted development tools, including OpenAI Codex, to improve development speed and quality.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the framework, development processes and coding standards.

Essential Skills and Experience

• Strong commercial experience developing applications using C# and .NET.
• Experience developing web applications using Blazor Server, Blazor WebAssembly, ASP.NET Core or a similar Microsoft web technology.
• Strong SQL Server knowledge, including:
o T-SQL
o Stored procedures
o Views
o Joins and aggregations
o Query optimisation
o Indexing
o Execution plans
o Data migration scripts
• Experience using Entity Framework or Entity Framework Core.
• Good understanding of object-oriented programming and software design principles.
• Experience developing REST APIs and integrating with third-party services.
• Experience with dependency injection and service-based application architecture.
• Experience using Git and source control workflows.
• Good understanding of application security, authentication and role-based permissions.
• Ability to investigate and resolve complex technical and business problems.
• Ability to work with existing applications and understand established business logic.
• Strong attention to detail and a focus on producing reliable, supportable software.
• Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively within a small development team.

Desirable Skills and Experience

The following experience would be beneficial but is not essential:

• VB.NET development experience.

• WinForms or WPF application development.
• Experience modernising or migrating desktop applications to web technologies.
• Crystal Reports development and support.
• Experience converting Crystal Reports into web-based or alternative reporting solutions.
• Microsoft Azure experience, including:
o Azure App Service
o Azure SQL Database
o Azure Storage
o Azure Functions
o Application Insights
o Key Vault
o Azure DevOps
o Microsoft Entra ID
• Experience with Microsoft Authentication Library (MSAL), single sign-on or multi-factor authentication.
• Experience building multi-tenant or multi-company SaaS applications.
• Experience with MAUI or cross-platform application development.
• Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript and responsive web design.
• Experience with component libraries such as Ignite UI.
• Experience developing dashboards, charts and operational reporting.
• Knowledge of background processing, scheduled services and message queues.
• Experience with document generation, barcode printing, label printing or local printing services.
• Experience integrating accounting, shipping, CRM, ERP or asset management systems.
• Experience working with AI development tools such as OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot or Azure AI services.
• Knowledge of prompt design, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation or vector search.
• Familiarity with secure software development practices and standards such as ISO 27001.
• Experience working within rental, asset management, service, maintenance, logistics or certification-based industries.

Technical Environment

The successful candidate is likely to work with technologies including:

  • C#
  • VB.NET
  • .NET and ASP.NET Core
  • Blazor Server
  • Entity Framework Core
  • SQL Server
  • Azure SQL Database
  • REST APIs
  • HTML and CSS
  • JavaScript
  • Microsoft Azure
  • Microsoft Entra ID and MSAL
  • Git and Azure DevOps
  • Crystal Reports
  • WinForms and WPF
  • .NET MAUI
  • OpenAI Codex and Azure AI services

Personal Characteristics

  • Practical and solutions-focused, with a passion for delivering business value.

  • Commercially aware, with the ability to connect technical solutions to business needs.

  • Confident working within complex and established technology environments.

  • Accountable, proactive, and committed to seeing work through to completion.

  • Focused on quality, maintainability, performance, security, and reliability.

  • Open to change, continuous improvement, and innovation.

  • Strong communicator with the ability to engage a wide range of stakeholders.

  • Adaptable and effective in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

  • Committed to the responsible use of AI and modern technologies to improve outcomes and efficiency.

Qualifications and Experience

• A degree or equivalent qualification in software development, computer science or a related subject is desirable.
• Equivalent commercial experience will also be considered.
• Previous experience in a commercial software development role is required.
• Experience delivering business-critical software to external customers would be advantageous.

Working Arrangements

This role will involve working closely with C-SAM’s development, operations, professional services and management teams.
The position may be office-based, hybrid or remote depending on the successful candidate’s location and experience.
Occasional travel may be required for team meetings, customer workshops, implementation support or training.
Some flexibility may occasionally be required when supporting international customers operating in different time zones.

What We Offer

• The opportunity to help shape a new application framework and product platform.
• A varied role involving new development, architecture, integrations and modernisation.
• Exposure to international customers and complex operational software.
• The opportunity to work with modern Microsoft and AI technologies.
• A small-team environment where individual contributions have a visible impact.
• Opportunities to influence technical direction, development standards and future products.
• Ongoing professional development and training.

Measures of Success

Success in the role will include:

• Delivering reliable functionality within agreed timescales.
• Producing maintainable and reusable framework components.
• Reducing defects and support issues through good design and testing.
• Improving application and database performance.
• Supporting the successful migration of Windows functionality into the web platform.
• Contributing positively to development standards, documentation and team knowledge.
• Using AI-assisted development tools effectively while maintaining appropriate code quality, security and review controls.
• Helping deliver a secure, scalable and commercially successful web platform.

C-SAM

37.5

More About Jonas Software:

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

Become a part of our caring community

The Senior Data Manager acquires, cleans and develops datasets from internal and external sources to support business analysis and reporting. The individual will acquire, validate, store, protect, and adhere to processes around data to ensure the accessibility, reliability, and timeliness of the data for its users. The candidate will also be responsible for developing and executing data architectures, policies, practices and procedures that properly manage the full data lifecycle needs of an enterprise.

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Ability to interact with business and IT departments in understanding user needs
  • Able to translate the business needs to technical requirements in terms of data needs
  • Be self-motivated and possess the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Possess the capacity to maintain confidentiality and work independently.
  • Identifies opportunities for process improvements
  • Coordinates with other teams to ensure all aspects of data needs are taken into account.
  • Coordination and completion of projects on time and within scope
  • Prepare data for reporting and analysis including visualizations to support business requirements.
  • Experience in performing in-depth data analysis to derive insights that drives business outcomes and decisions.
  • Exhibit strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Be an innovative thinker with an innate curiosity around data
  • Be self-motivated and possess the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
  • Experience in problem analysis and process documentation


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree

  • Extensive experience developing stored procedures and dynamic SQL
  • Strong working knowledge of Cloud Technologies (For example Azure Synapse Analytics, Snowflake and/or related cloud technology) and Power Platforms (Power BI, Power Automate, & Power Apps)
  • Experience taking complex data and making it more accessible, understandable and usable for leaders to derive insights
  • Experiencing leading projects through entire life cycle, from design, coding, code review and deployment
  • Proficient in root cause analysis
  • Demonstrated ability to problem solve and provide solutions for business or data issues

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering and/or related field

Description

Duve (duve.com) is a fast-growing hospitality tech company helping hotels modernize the guest experience through a personalized Guest Experience Suite. With customers in 70+ countries, Duve empowers hotels, vacation rentals, and hospitality brands to digitize and personalize every step of the guest journey. Duve is scaling growth in multiple markets, and Germany is a key growth focus as we expand our presence across the region.

Location: Remote (Germany)

Travel: Attend local events and visit properties to connect with potential customers

Department: Sales

Type: Full-time

﻿What to Expect – Your Journey with Us

In this role, you’ll help build Duve’s Germany presence from the ground up—running consultative sales cycles with hotel leaders and turning market feedback into wins and learnings that shape our go-to-market.

About this Role

As an Account Executive (Germany), you’ll own the full sales cycle for new customers across Germany—from discovery to close and handoff. You’ll run a consultative process with hospitality stakeholders, build pipeline through outbound, inbound and local field activity, and collaborate closely with BDRs and Marketing to accelerate growth.

Requirements

Must-have

  • 4+ years experience closing B2B SaaS / technology deals (new business), including 2+ years closing Midmarket/Enterprise deals ; hospitality tech exposure is a strong plus
  • Proven consultative selling skills: discovery, demo storytelling, objection handling, negotiation
  • Comfortable building pipeline through outbound efforts (not only inbound)
  • Fluency in German and English (spoken and written)
  • Experience working with a CRM (Salesforce preferred)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience selling into hotels, multi-property groups, or chains
  • Familiarity with hospitality workflows and/or systems (PMS, guest messaging, payments, digital check-in/out)
  • Experience navigating procurement and legal processes

What you'll do

  • Own the full sales process: outreach, discovery, demo, solution design, proposal, negotiation, contracting, close, and handoff to Customer Success
  • Lead consultative conversations connecting customer needs to outcomes across guest experience and hotel operations
  • Build and progress pipeline through outbound prospecting, events, and property visits (in addition to inbound leads)
  • Collaborate with BDRs on target accounts and account plans; align on messaging, sequencing, and follow-up
  • Navigate multi-stakeholder buying groups (GM, Operations, Revenue, Digital/IT, Finance) with strong stakeholder mapping and multithreading
  • Maintain accurate CRM hygiene (Salesforce preferred), forecasting discipline, and clear deal next steps.
  • Collaborate with internal teams including Product/ Customer Success/ Marketing (sharing competitive insights, objections, customer needs and other market feedbacks), to strengthen positioning and win rates

Join the VRChat Team!

VRChat offers a first-of-its-kind, game-changing platform that provides an endless collection of social VR experiences and gives the power of creation to its robust community. With over 250,000 worlds and growing, VRChat’s vision is to allow users to bring their imaginations to life and help shape the metaverse anywhere in the world on any device. VRChat has raised $100M to date with the support of investors, Makers Fund, Anthos Capital and HTC.

We have a great team which includes people from: Netflix, Twitter, Meta, Microsoft, Roblox, Google, Amazon, Unity, Spotify, Discord, Uber, eBay, Robinhood, Twitch, Zynga and TikTok. Come and join the mission!

Job Overview

We’re looking for a full-stack engineer to join our Trust and Safety Tech team. We hire engineers to solve real user problems, not implement specs. You will be instrumental in discovering, developing, and refining the internal and external functionality that ensure users can find belonging within a safe, engaging environment. Your work will help ensure VRChat scales safely, protecting growth and trust by reducing harm with low friction. This role involves working within Node.js/Mongo backend and React frontend to deliver low-friction, scalable moderation, anti-abuse, and safety systems.

Who You Are

A pragmatic, full-stack engineer who treats safety and privacy as first-class design constraints. Comfortable across the MERN stack, comfortable with adversarial thinking, and comfortable being on-call for systems that matter.

What You'll Do

  • Work within a full-stack team to develop, implement, and maintain new features for the VRChat platform and operational team.

  • Focus on enhancing safety systems, building the UI/UX and backend systems for support, moderation, and safety operations, with consideration for cost and user privacy.

  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers across the stack to translate product and design vision into functional code through informed tradeoffs and accurate estimates.

  • Contribute to all stages of the feature lifecycle, from initial concept and prototyping to deployment and post-launch iteration and maintenance.

  • Ensure the usability, stability, reliability, and performance of critical moderation and safety services, participating in on-call rotations as needed.

  • Participate in code reviews to maintain a high bar for code quality, architectural integrity, performance, and reliability while spreading knowledge across the team.

  • Contribute to a culture embracing collaborative, iterative, outcome-focused, product-discovery-driven delivery.

Qualifications

  • Professional experience developing, building and maintaining web applications, preferably in social or gaming contexts.

  • Proficiency in the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) and related technologies like Redis.

  • Experience building scalable, RESTful APIs.

  • Experience building usable, responsive web front ends using React and CSS, or other similar technologies.

  • Experience with database design and optimization, state management, and third-party integrations.

  • Familiarity with version control systems and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Experience with operational excellence: observability, on-call, incident response, and reliability practices for production systems.

  • Comfort designing systems with adversarial users in mind: anticipating abuse vectors, false-positive costs, and graceful degradation.

  • Experience handling sensitive user data with appropriate privacy and access controls.

  • Comfort collaborating with non-engineering partners (operations, legal, policy) on product trade-offs.

  • An agile, collaborative, product mindset and excellent communication skills, capable of working effectively in a remote, cross-functional team environment.

  • Demonstrated interest in online communities, VR, or VRChat (as a user or creator).

Bonus Points

  • Understanding of a game client/server architecture and data flow, especially as it relates to telemetry or abuse vectors.

  • Experience with Unity/C# (for in-game safety UI surfaces like reporting flows).

  • Experience with ML-adjacent systems (model serving, evaluation, human-in-the-loop pipelines).

  • Experience working in, or directly with, moderation or Trust and Safety teams.

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, GCP) and containerization (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes.)

Benefits

  • Work from anywhere! VRChat is a 100% remote company offering flexible working hours in combination with core hours supporting real-time collaboration

  • Health Benefits

  • 401K for US & Group RRSP for Canadian Employees

  • Stock Options

  • Generous paid holiday schedule

  • Unlimited/flexible vacation time

  • Paid parental leave benefits

VRChat is an equal-opportunity employer, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. VRChat fosters a diverse, creative, and collaborative environment where anyone can contribute to any of the ongoing projects or direction of the roadmap at any time. If you’re a passionate team player who wants to have an impact on a dynamic team, we’d love to hear from you!

All job offers are subject to satisfactory referencing and background checks.

raw.description:
Porch Group is a leading vertical software and insurance platform and is positioned to be the best partner to help homebuyers move, maintain, and fully protect their homes. We offer differentiated products and services, with homeowners insurance at the center of this relationship. We differentiate and look to win in the massive and growing homeowners insurance opportunity by 1) providing the best services for homebuyers, 2) led by advantaged underwriting in insurance, 3) to protect the whole home.

As a leader in the home services software-as-a-service (“SaaS”) space, we’ve built deep relationships with approximately 30 thousand companies that are key to the home-buying transaction, such as home inspectors, mortgage companies, and title companies.

In 2020, Porch Group rang the Nasdaq bell and began trading under the ticker symbol PRCH. We are looking to build a truly great company and are JUST GETTING STARTED.

Job Title: Senior Platform Engineer - AI Platform

Location: United States

Workplace Type: Remote

Job Summary

The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we'd love for you to be a part of it as our Senior Platform Engineer - AI Platform.

ISN is hiring a Senior Platform Engineer to lead AI-first platform work at the intersection of agentic systems and production infrastructure. You'll design and ship the systems that let agents and LLMs do real work inside a high-volume product — spanning scheduling, report intake, customer communication, billing workflows, and data extraction. You'll also own the foundation underneath it: our PHP application, AWS/ECS infrastructure, and MySQL/Aurora data layer. This role offers unusual latitude to define how AI works at ISN, backed by the scale and stability of Porch Group and the data of a category-leading home inspection software platform.

What You Will Do As A Senior Platform Engineer - AI Platform

  • Build AI features end to end — retrieval, context engineering, structured output, tool/function calling, and evaluation harnesses that measure whether a change actually made things better
  • Design and operate agent orchestration systems — multi-agent and multi-step workflows including task decomposition, tool routing, state and memory, retries and fallbacks, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and guardrails against failure modes that don't look like exceptions
  • Operate non-deterministic systems responsibly — tracing, evals in CI, prompt and model versioning, token and latency budgets, model routing, and cost controls
  • Own ECS container platform operations — service definitions, task sizing, autoscaling, blue/green deploys, and orchestration for both long-running services and async workers
  • Architect AWS infrastructure — event-driven and serverless pipelines (Lambda, SQS/SNS/EventBridge), IAM and network design, all managed as infrastructure as code
  • Build and extend services in our production PHP codebase, integrating AI capability into existing product surfaces without destabilizing them
  • Drive database performance at scale — schema design, indexing, replication and read scaling, zero-downtime migrations, and query performance work across MySQL and Aurora
  • Raise the bar across the team through code review, design docs, mentorship, incident response, and on-call participation

What You Will Bring As A Senior Platform Engineer - AI Platform

  • 10+ years building and running production software, with real ownership of systems at scale
  • Demonstrated, hands-on experience shipping LLM-backed features — not just API calls, but agent orchestration, RAG, evaluation, and the operational discipline to keep them working
  • Strong PHP (8.x) skills in a mature, high-traffic codebase
  • Deep AWS architecture experience with hands-on ECS operations, infrastructure as code (Terraform or CDK), and CI/CD
  • Expert-level relational database skills with MySQL and/or Aurora — able to read an execution plan and act on it
  • Strong fundamentals in distributed systems, API design, observability, and application security
  • Clear written communication and sound judgment about tradeoffs, especially where AI is the wrong tool for the job
  • Nice to have: Go, MCP or comparable agent-tooling standards, vector search and embedding pipelines, Kubernetes, document and image extraction pipelines, or real estate/proptech/field-services domain experience

The application window for this position is anticipated to close in 2 weeks (10 business days) from 8/12/2026. Please know this may change based on business and interviewing needs.

At this time, Porch Group does not consider applicants from the following states or jurisdictions for Remote positions: Alaska, Delaware, Hawaii, Mississippi, Nebraska, Montana, New Hampshire, West Virginia, or the District of Columbia.

What You Will Get As A Porch Group Team Member

Pay Range:* $168,800 – $236,300 annually

*Please know your actual pay at Porch will reflect a number of factors among which are your work experience and skillsets, job-related knowledge, alignment with market and our Porch employees, as well as your geographic location.

Additionally, you will be eligible to receive long-term incentive awards, subject to program guidelines and approvals.

Our benefits package will provide you with comprehensive coverage for your health, life, and financial wellbeing.

  • Our traditional healthcare benefits include three (3) Medical plan options, two (2) Dental plan options, and a Vision plan from which to choose.
  • Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity and Accident plans are offered on a voluntary basis.
  • We offer pre-tax savings options including a partially employer funded Health Savings Account and employee Flexible Savings Accounts including healthcare, dependent care, and transportation savings options.
  • We provide company paid Basic Life and AD&D, Short and Long-Term Disability benefits. We also offer Voluntary Life and AD&D plans.
  • Both traditional and Roth 401(k) plans are available with a discretionary employer match.
  • Supportlinc is part of our employer paid wellbeing program and provides employees and their families access to on demand guided meditation and mindfulness exercises, mental health coaching, clinical care and online access to confidential resources including will preparation.
  • LifeBalance is a free resource to employees and their families for year-round discounts on things like gym memberships, travel, appliances, movies, pet insurance and more.
  • Our wellness programs include flexible paid vacation, company-paid holidays of typically nine per year, paid sick time, paid parental leave, identity theft program, travel assistance, and fitness and other discounts programs.

What’s next?

Submit your application and our Porch Group Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing your application shortly! If your resume gets us intrigued, we will look to connect with you for a chat to learn more about your background, and then possibly invite you to have virtual interviews. What's important to call out is that we want to make sure not only that you're the right person for us, but also that we're the right next step for you, so come prepared with all the questions you have!

Porch is committed to building an inclusive culture of belonging that not only embraces the diversity of our people but also reflects the diversity of the communities in which we work and the customers we serve. We know that the happiest and highest performing teams include people with diverse perspectives that encourage new ways of solving problems, so we strive to attract and develop talent from all backgrounds and create workplaces where everyone feels seen, heard and empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work.

Porch is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

Porch Group is an E-Verify employer. E-Verify is a web-based system that allows an employer to determine an employee's eligibility to work in the US using information reported on an employee's Form I-9. The E-Verify system confirms eligibility with both the Social Security Administration (SSA) and Department of Homeland Security (DHS). For more information, please go to theUSCIS E-Verify website.

We are mission-driven to advance wellbeing across the Quality of Life ecosystem through impactful leadership. Come join us!

THE ROLE

This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated and proactive team player with emphasis on organization, customer service, professionalism, and quality to support the Global Leadership Advisory Executive Partner, Global Board Advisory Senior Partner, and Principal. The Advisory Project Coordinator provides support by managing project coordination, administrative tasks, and client-related processes to ensure efficient execution of engagements via strong communication, demonstrated technical skills, and ability to problem-solve and anticipate and address potential issues in advance.

The position will provide comprehensive logistical and operation support across a broad range of activities, including complex calendar and time management, travel coordination, document development, database management, and event planning, while contributing to a highly collaborative, team-oriented environment. The position will also provide logistical and operational support to coordinate project delivery and other time-sensitive search and consulting support. These engagements typically involve boards, CEOs, and other C-suite members.

The Advisory Project Coordinator operates in a dynamic, fast-paced, and deadline driven environment with shifting priorities and varying workflow volumes, all while consistently delivering high-quality work and an exceptional client experience.

Work will be conducted in a remote environment. This position offers a base salary of $77,000 to $87,000, plus a target bonus of 5% of base salary. Salary within our ranges is determined by your education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as required by the role, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. WittKieffer offers a full benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), life and disability insurances, and generous paid time off.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Aligned to multiple Executive Partners and Leadership Advisory Solution leaders to provide high-level administrative support across all phases of project delivery including but not limited to:

Project Coordination:

  • Provide high-level coordination support to senior consultants supporting the organization and management of client engagements through structured planning, prioritization, and execution of key activities.

  • Proactively anticipate and drive business priorities, aligning consultant and client needs to ensure seamless project delivery and responsiveness.

  • Deliver a high-touch client experience by providing consistent professional support and maintaining strong communication across all stages of the engagement.

  • Maintain accurate and current project tracking across engagements, ensuring visibility into timelines, milestones, and deliverables.

  • Oversee the coordination and tracking of invoicing and expense processing, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and alignment with project and financial requirements.

Calendar Management and Scheduling:

  • Oversee complex calendar management for consulting staff within the solution, including aligning competing priorities, resolving scheduling conflicts, and ensuring optimal time allocation across engagements.

  • Support planning and scheduling for internal and external project meetings, etc.

  • Coordinate travel logistics as needed, with a focus on efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and alignment with project and client requirements.

  • Create documentation, as needed, for key meetings. Ensure materials for meetings are prepared and distributed in a timely manner. Record action items from meetings and conduct appropriate follow-ups.

Team Collaboration and Communication:

  • Demonstrate professional verbal and written communication skills across diverse formats, including client correspondence, reports, proposals, presentations and emails, ensuring clarity, precision, and professionalism in all interactions.

  • Develop a partnership with consultants built on communication, trust, and teamwork.

  • Successfully collaborate across multiple departments and practices to ensure quality and timing of project deliverables.

  • Provide a high degree of discretion, sound judgment, and professionalism in handling sensitive and confidential information.

  • Contribute to a collaborative team environment by providing flexible support and stepping in to assist colleagues as needed to ensure seamless project execution and continuity.

Document and Data Management:

  • Create, edit, and proofread client deliverables including templates, proposals, engagement contracts, and reports, all in accordance with the firm's brand standards.

  • Support the tracking and management of project tasks and critical information, leveraging appropriate tools to ensure accuracy, visibility, and alignment across engagements.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree preferred.

  • 10+ years' experience in business operations or working on project teams in professional service organizations.

  • Experience working with CEOs and Boards of Directors, both internally and externally.

  • Experience working with members of executive leadership teams.

  • Experience as a project coordinator and senior-level executive assistant is strongly preferred.

  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, PowerPoint and Word, and experience with collaboration technologies (e.g., Zoom, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, etc.).

  • Experience with project management tools and software tools used to build flow charts and process diagrams a plus (e.g., Monday, etc.).

  • Proven ability to learn and navigate new software tools and applications.

  • Proven ability to multi-task and prioritize while managing multiple projects simultaneously.

  • High attention to detail and experience creating, proofreading, and editing business documents with the ability to make recommendations for improvements.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.

  • Eastern or Central time zone location with experience working remotely, preferred.

Critical Competencies:

  • Collaborative: Establishes open, candid, and trusting relationships. Demonstrates exceptional verbal and written communications skills; proactively and constructively shares information, ideas, and feedback with others.

  • Committed: Self-motivated and deadline driven work ethic. Independently manages operational tasks to completion. Strong organizational and multi-tasking skills. Pays attention to the details and produces quality outputs and/or experiences.

  • Adaptive: Ability to be flexible and re-prioritize work, as requested, and needed. Responds resourcefully to new demands and challenges. Encourages new ways of looking at problems, processes, or solutions. Helps others positively embrace change. Works constructively and calmly under stress and pressure.

  • Growing: Demonstrates a "can-do" attitude and willingness to always be learning and perform a wide variety of tasks required to meet evolving operational needs.

  • Teamwork: Demonstrates a calm and confident approach to relationships/teams and ability to work your strengths in areas of communication, calendar management, and client relationships.

Witt/Kieffer Inc. ("WittKieffer") provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants. WittKieffer will recruit, employ, train, promote and compensate our employees without regard to race, religion, creed, color, national origin, citizenship, gender, pregnancy, military status, age, marital status, sexual orientation, sexual identity, disability or any other personal characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law. WittKieffer will endeavor to make reasonable accommodation, as required by law, for qualified individuals with known disabilities or religious practices unless doing so would result in an undue hardship on the operation of our business.

raw.description:
About the Role

A fast-growing, seed-stage AI developer tools company is hiring a Pre-Sales Deployed Engineer based in London (German-speaking candidates also considered). This is a rare hybrid role for engineers who can genuinely both code and sell — you'll serve as the technical expert partnering with Account Executives to close enterprise deals, running hands-on technical pilots with development teams at prospective customers.

You'll work 100% on-site five days a week in London. Visa sponsorship is available.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with sales to qualify opportunities and act as the primary technical advisor throughout the pre-sales cycle — from discovery through to a successful close.

  • Run structured multi-week technical pilots with enterprise dev teams: lead kickoff calls, host regular office hours, and pair-program directly with customer engineers to demonstrate real-world value.

  • Present the product's vision, benefits, and differentiators to audiences ranging from individual developers to C-suite executives.

  • Deliver technical training sessions, live demos, and create customer-facing documentation, guides, and enablement resources.

  • Build and maintain technical collateral (demos, blogs, videos, guides) tailored to enterprise use cases.

  • Gather and synthesize customer feedback, feeding actionable insights back to Product and Engineering to influence the roadmap.

  • Travel to customer sites and industry events as needed to support engagements.

What We're Looking For

Must-haves:

  • 1+ years of solutions or pre-sales engineering experience for a technical product; developer tooling experience strongly preferred.

  • Strong CS fundamentals — CS degree from a top programme or equivalent demonstrated experience.

  • Solid programming skills in at least one object-oriented language; comfortable pair-programming live with customer engineers.

  • Fluency in both German and English.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered developer tools (code completion, AI chat assistants, or similar LLM-based tools).

  • Proven ability to deliver technical training, live demos, and create customer-facing documentation and enablement content.

  • Willingness to travel to customer sites and events as required.

  • A genuine interest in and aptitude for sales — high EQ, a closing mindset, and executive presence.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience engaging and presenting to C-suite and executive stakeholders.

  • Track record of successful enterprise software deployments or driving customer adoption initiatives.

  • Experience gathering customer feedback to inform product roadmap decisions.

This role is not for:

  • Pure software engineers with no interest in sales or customer-facing work.

  • Sales professionals who rely on others for technical depth.

  • Solutions engineers who have historically outsourced technical work to separate support teams.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: $108,000 – $140,000 USD annually (London-based; EUR-equivalent compensation may apply for Germany-based candidates).

  • Visa sponsorship available.

Location

  • Primary: London, England, UK — 100% on-site, five days per week.

  • Germany-based candidates may also be considered; workplace details and currency may vary.

STAR Bonus % (At Risk Maximum)

M-F 8-5pm

Remote Work Notification

ATTENTION: Lighthouse is unable to offer remote work to residents of Alaska, Delaware, Hawaii, Idaho, Iowa, Louisiana, Maine, Mississippi, Montana, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New Mexico, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Rode Island, South Carolina, South Dakota, Vermont, West Virginia, and Wyoming.

Overview

Due to growth, we are adding a Analyst, Provider Quality to our team!

The Analyst, Provider Quality assists the Manager, Provider Quality in executing and maintaining provider and prescriber data quality that directly impact pharmacy claims accuracy, regulatory compliance, and operational performance. This role monitors prescriber data for accuracy and integrity, investigates and resolves data quality issues, and ensures adherence to established governance controls and regulatory requirements.

The Analyst, Provider Quality works cross-functionally with Compliance, SIU, IT, and business stakeholders to support audit readiness, manage data-related risks, and improve data accuracy across internal systems and external data sources. The Analyst, Provider Quality also contributes to process improvements, reporting, and automation efforts to enhance data governance, operational efficiency, and overall quality outcomes.

Is this you? Find out more below!

Responsibilities

How do I make an impact on my team?

  • Monitor, validate, and maintain provider and prescriber data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with regulatory and organizational requirements.
  • Ensure proper intake, triage, and prioritization of data quality issues, ensuring timely resolution based on risk, impact, and business needs.
  • Investigate and resolve data discrepancies or duplications impacting claims adjudication, system performance, and reporting integrity.
  • Assist with the resolution of Prescriber Edits on claims.
  • Perform root cause analysis to identify recurring issues and recommend corrective actions to improve data quality and prevent reoccurrence.
  • Support validation and reconciliation of internal and external data sources, including vendor-provided data feeds and enrichment files.
  • Outreach to prescriber data authorities, including CMS and State Medicaid Programs, to resolve data clarity issues.
  • Assist with and resolve issues related to sanction monitoring, defects, state or federal exclusion conflicts or other provider restrictions that may impact claims.
  • Escalate complex challenges, overrides, or data conflicts timely and inclusive of actions already taken.
  • Prepare and validate documentation to support audit readiness, regulatory inquiries, and client requests, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
  • Execute established data governance controls, including data validation checks, exception handling, and adherence to defined processes.
  • Maintain and update standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and supporting documentation related to provider data quality processes.
  • Track, analyze, and communicate data quality trends, risks, and performance metrics to inform decision-making and process improvement.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

What our team expects from you?

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience required.
  • 2 years of experience working with provider data and/or validation through healthcare billing, accounts receivable, or credentialing required.
  • Experience with data analysis, healthcare claims processing, issue resolution, and process improvement required.
  • Participate in, adhere to, and support compliance program objectives.
  • The ability to consistently interact cooperatively and respectfully with other employees.

What can you expect from Navitus?

  • Top of the industry benefits for Health, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • 20 days paid time off
  • 4 weeks paid parental leave
  • 9 paid holidays
  • 401K company match of up to 5% - No vesting requirement
  • Adoption Assistance Program
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Educational Assistance Plan and Professional Membership assistance
  • Referral Bonus Program – up to $750!

The Opportunity:

At Avantor, people are the most important part of our success because they drive our global performance. That’s why our Operations, Lab Services, Sales, and many other Avantor teams rely on our talent acquisition initiatives to attract, engage and hire the right talent. Avantor’s Planning vertical is a crucial part of this mix, enabling all our internal teams worldwide to grow beyond their limits.

The S&OE (Sales & Operations Execution) Coordinator is the end-to-end process owner of the S&OE process responsible for managing daily and weekly operations plans, aligning demand and supply activities, and ensuring that short-term operational goals are met. The role involves close collaboration with sales, production, procurement, and logistics teams to address real-time challenges and adjust plans as needed to meet customer expectations, while aligning closely with Sales and Operating Planning (S&OP) processes.

This person is a well-rounded individual who encompasses strong analytical and communication skills. They can work under pressure and cross-functionally, to drive alignment with limited guidance and supervision.

What we’re looking for:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field.
  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in supply chain, operations, or production planning. Familiarity with S&OP or S&OE processes is preferred.

Who you are:

  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proficiency in using ERP systems (SAP), Microsoft Office Suite and Power BI.
  • Analytical and problem-solving mindset with attention to detail.
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
  • APICS/CPIM certification desirable.

How you will thrive and create and impact:

Coordination and Communication

  • Support execution of the S&OE plan on a weekly and daily basis.
  • Act as a liaison between sales, production, procurement, and logistics teams.
  • Communicate operational changes and adjustments to stakeholders promptly.
  • Facilitate daily or weekly meetings to address bottlenecks or urgent issues.

Performance Monitoring and Reporting

  • Develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as service levels, inventory accuracy, and order fulfillment rates.
  • Analyze variances between plans and actual performance, providing actionable insights.
  • Prepare and share reports with management on operational performance, including executive level communication.

Issue Resolution

  • Work with planning and cross functional teams to identify and address short-term supply chain disruptions or constraints.
  • Collaborate with teams to resolve issues affecting order fulfillment or production schedules.
  • Develop contingency plans to mitigate risks in operations.

Continuous Improvement

  • Support initiatives to improve efficiency in operational execution.
  • Provide feedback to enhance S&OP processes based on S&OE insights.
  • Develop reporting requirements and future tools to drive towards data driven decision making.
  • Contribute to streamlining workflows and optimizing resource utilization.

Disclaimer:

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Avantor is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Why Avantor?

Dare to go further in your career. Join our global team of 14,000+ associates whose passion for discovery and determination to overcome challenges relentlessly advances life-changing science.

The work we do changes people's lives for the better. It brings new patient treatments and therapies to market, giving a cancer survivor the chance to walk his daughter down the aisle. It enables medical devices that help a little boy hear his mom's voice for the first time. Outcomes such as these create unlimited opportunities for you to contribute your talents, learn new skills and grow your career at Avantor.

We are committed to helping you on this journey through our diverse, equitable and inclusive culture which includes learning experiences to support your career growth and success. At Avantor, dare to go further and see how the impact of your contributions set science in motion to create a better world. Apply today!

$78,000.00 - $125,350.00

Actual pay may differ depending on relevant factors such as prior experience and geographic location.

About Clarity Pediatrics:

Clarity Pediatrics is reimagining pediatric chronic care, starting with ADHD. Nearly 10% of people in the US are diagnosed with ADHD, and for parents, it can feel impossible to find the right care. We are building a virtual pediatric ADHD clinic that delivers trusted care to all families. Our new clinical model is tech-enabled, backed by the best science, and has the potential to deliver exceptional health outcomes to transform a child’s trajectory. In the future, our pediatric care platform will expand rapidly to other common chronic conditions like asthma, allergies, and obesity.

Our co-founders and leadership team have deep commitment to clinical excellence and domain expertise in healthcare. Our CEO, Christina LaMontagne, has led two startups and earned her MBA at Harvard Business School. Our Chief Medical Officer, Alesandro Larrazabal, MD, trained at UCSF and Stanford. Until recently, he was a Medical Director building specialty care services at Kaiser Permanente. Earlier, he worked at IDEO.

About the Role

We are seeking an Arizona-licensed Therapist to support the launch of our behavioral health services in Arizona. This contract position will assist with payer enrollment, credentialing, and clinical readiness activities as we expand access to care in the state.

  • Interest in supporting innovative, technology-enabled care delivery models

raw.title: Senior Product Manager, Caper Recommendations & Personalization
raw.excerpt: We're transforming the grocery industryAt Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together.
raw.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Caper is at the forefront of Physical AI, building smart shopping carts that sense and respond to the real world in real time. By bringing intelligence onto the cart, Caper digitizes the entire in-store shopping journey, turning every trip into an interactive, personalized experience from the first item added to checkout. Our plug-and-play technology requires no store renovation or operational overhaul — retailers simply add Caper Carts and instantly upgrade their stores into connected, intelligent shopping environments. Caper is one of the fastest-growing retail automation technology products in the market and is already widely adopted across the industry.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own recommendations and personalization on the Caper Cart. In this role, you will define how the cart decides what to show each shopper, when to show it, and how it adapts to who they are. Every recommendation, moment of inspiration, and ranking decision on the cart screen runs through the systems you will build and refine.

This is a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of recommendation systems, machine learning, and a physical shopping experience that unfolds in real time as a customer moves through a store. You will blend ML and data science work with hands-on UX design thinking, partnering closely with Instacart's discovery and personalization platforms while shaping a first-of-its-kind experience for the Caper customer. You will report to the Group Product Manager for Caper Customer Value and work alongside a tight-knit team of three product managers, with broad cross-functional reach across Engineering, Data Science, Design, Ads, and Operations.

About the Job

  • Set and own the vision for recommendations and personalization on Caper. Caper turns the store itself into a personalization surface, where every item added and every step through the store is a chance to show something useful in the moment. You will drive Engagement as a primary pillar metric — growing customer interactions, building monetizable surfaces, and diversifying the content mix to serve savings, discovery, and health-focused shoppers.
  • Own the system that decides what to show and when. Mature recommendation and item ranking using machine learning, including LLM-based techniques, and use real-time signals — cart location and motion, lists, search, and Instacart personalization data — to deliver content at the moments it is most relevant rather than constant or intrusive.
  • Drive AI-first innovation to expand what Caper shows shoppers. Ship net-new content types with nuanced product information and pairings tailored to each individual, and lead the architecture for capturing real-time, in-session signals that make personalization feel genuinely intelligent.
  • Champion a high-quality, intuitive shopping experience by partnering closely with Design to translate complex personalization logic into interactions that feel simple and natural on the cart screen. Spend time in labs and partner stores to observe real shopper behavior, test features, and iterate quickly based on what you learn.
  • Run a fast, experiment-driven roadmap and serve as the product lead for recommendations and personalization across the organization — aligning senior stakeholders on strategy, tradeoffs, and progress, and partnering cross-functionally with Engineering, Data Science, Design, Ads, and Operations from discovery through launch with clear PRDs and measurable success criteria.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of product management experience or equivalent practical experience
  • Experience partnering with ML or data science teams to ship models into a production consumer product
  • Experience defining and driving engagement or relevance metrics, and using experimentation to move them
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage data and quantitative analysis to make sound decisions in ambiguous environments
  • Track record of close partnership with UX design teams and applying strong design thinking practices throughout the product development process
  • Strong communication and influencing skills, with experience presenting to large groups and aligning multiple senior stakeholders on strategy and tradeoffs

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building recommendation, personalization, ranking, or search products
  • Experience with consumer-facing hardware, IoT, or physical retail products
  • Familiarity with retail, grocery, ads, or marketplace recommendation systems

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.
