About This Role

The Senior Clinical Trial Transparency Specialist leads clinical trial transparency activities for assigned studies, helping ensure that trial registration and results information are disclosed accurately, on time, and in accordance with global requirements. You will serve as a key partner to study teams, internal stakeholders, and external vendors—coordinating planning, execution, quality oversight, and issue resolution across the disclosure lifecycle. This role contributes directly to Biogen’s commitment to meaningful, patient-centered communication of clinical research information. You will also help strengthen the efficiency, quality, and consistency of Clinical Trial Transparency processes, technology, training, and vendor operations. This position reports to the Head, Clinical Trial Transparency Operations and works closely with Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs, Medical Writing, Data Management, and external service providers.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead disclosure planning and delivery for assigned clinical studies

  • Coordinate protocol registration, record maintenance, and results disclosure activities

  • Serve as the primary Clinical Trial Transparency contact for assigned study teams

  • Partner with vendors to deliver accurate, timely, high-quality registry disclosures

  • Monitor vendor workload, performance metrics, cycle times, and issue logs

  • Escalate disclosure risks, dependencies, and quality concerns as appropriate

  • Support planning, coordination, and quality review of plain language summaries

  • Improve Clinical Trial Transparency processes, work instructions, SOPs, and training

  • Provide user feedback and support testing for Clinical Trial Transparency technology solutions

  • Represent the function on cross-functional initiatives and continuous-improvement projects

Who You Are

You are a detail-oriented clinical research professional who is passionate about transparency, compliance, and making clinical trial information understandable and accessible to the public. You balance strong operational execution with a continuous-improvement mindset and enjoy collaborating across study teams, vendors, and internal functions. You are comfortable managing competing priorities, navigating complex global requirements, and translating them into clear, practical action.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in a science related field

  • 4+ years of relevant pharmaceutical-industry experience or equivalent

  • 2+ years experience of global clinical trial transparency knowledge and disclosure requirements

  • Experience with clinical trial registration and results disclosure activities

  • Understanding of clinical study and program communication-planning dependencies

  • Process mapping and continuous improvement experience

  • Vendor-management experience in an outsourced operating model

  • Ability to monitor deliverables, quality, timelines, metrics, and issues

  • Familiarity with Clinical Trial Transparency technology, systems, and tools

  • Knowledge of plain language summaries and patient-centered trial communication

  • Strong cross-functional communication and stakeholder-management skills

Preferred Skills

  • Experience supporting or leading SOP, work-instruction, or training updates

  • Familiarity with data sharing, patient engagement, health equity, or digital engagement

Job Level: Management

Additional Information

The base compensation range for this role is: $116,000.00-$155,000.00

Base salary offered is determined through an analytical approach utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills & experience, job location, and internal equity.


Regular employees are eligible to receive both short term and long-term incentives, including cash bonus and equity incentive opportunities, designed to reward recent achievements and recognize your future potential based on individual, business unit and company performance.


In addition to compensation, Biogen offers a full and highly competitive range of benefits designed to support our employees’ and their families physical, financial, emotional, and social well-being; including, but not limited to:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, & Life insurances
  • Fitness & Wellness programs including a fitness reimbursement
  • Short- and Long-Term Disability insurance
  • A minimum of 15 days of paid vacation and an additional end-of-year shutdown time off (Dec 26-Dec 31)
  • Up to 12 company paid holidays + 3 paid days off for Personal Significance
  • 80 hours of sick time per calendar year
  • Paid Maternity and Parental Leave benefit
  • 401(k) program participation with company matched contributions
  • Employee stock purchase plan
  • Tuition reimbursement of up to $10,000 per calendar year
  • Employee Resource Groups participation

Why Biogen?

We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. As a mid-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills. Above all, we work together to deliver life-changing medicines, with every role playing a vital part in our mission. Caring Deeply. Achieving Excellence. Changing Lives.


At Biogen, we are committed to building on our culture of inclusion and belonging that reflects the communities where we operate and the patients we serve. We know that diverse backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives make us a stronger and more innovative company, and we are focused on building teams where every employee feels empowered and inspired. Read on to learn more about Biogen.

title: Sell-Side Transaction Manager - manda
description: The companySmall businesses move fast.  Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight.

raw.title: Sell-Side Transaction Manager - manda
raw.excerpt: The companySmall businesses move fast.  Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight.
raw.description:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

We're looking for a Sell-Side Transaction Manager to join the manda Deal Team! You will work with small business owners to help them successfully sell their businesses, across the entire M&A process.

manda is where AI meets Mergers & Acquisitions, iwoca's new M&A platform. Over the last months we have built an unbeatable proposition for the UK market of buying and selling small businesses. As a result, our pipeline has been growing rapidly, and we’re now looking to expand.

It is still difficult for business owners to sell their business or buy others in the sub-£10m EV market. Information asymmetry, lack of knowledge and low transaction amounts make it challenging. Many M&A companies shy away from serving this segment as they find it hard to do so profitably.

Iwoca has a deep footprint into the SME economy, with 150,000+ business as customers in the UK alone. We enabled this success by iwoca’s ability to build clean, efficient, and automated processes, which manda will now leverage to build the only M&A platform in the UK.

Your mission is to build and close a portfolio of seller mandates, sourced from three channels we already run: inbound from iwoca's 150,000+ SME customers, automated outbound to vendors matching live buyer mandates, and referrals from the searchers and acquirers in our buy-side pipeline. You won't be cold-calling from a list, but you will rigorously qualify a managed flow of warm leads. Your job includes challenges like establishing price realism and evaluating company sellability. Ultimately deciding which mandates are worth progressing and converting into completed transactions.

The team

You'll join the founding team building manda as a high-growth venture inside iwoca, with the autonomy and pace of a startup and the data, infrastructure, and credibility of a lender with 150,000+ SME customers behind you.

Day-to-day you'll work alongside our first sell-side Transaction Manager, splitting the seller portfolio and trading playbooks as we figure out what works. You'll partner closely with our buy-side Transaction Manager, who runs a live pipeline of qualified searchers and acquirers, that's your buyer pool, not a cold market. You'll also work directly with the Venture Lead on positioning, pricing, and the bigger calls on how the platform evolves.

The role

You'll own the sell-side journey of your portfolio end-to-end, from intake through completion. What makes this different from a traditional brokerage seat: you're not hunting for buyers on the open market. manda runs a live buy-side pipeline of qualified searchers and acquirers, and we're piloting acquisition finance through iwoca, so the buyers you bring to your sellers are pre-qualified and often pre-financed. Your edge is a structured process, a captive buyer pool, and the ability to put financing on the table. Your job is to convert that edge into closed transactions.

The requirements

  • 3+ years of SME M&A experience from a broker, advisory firm, or deal platform, with evidence of end-to-end deal execution under time pressure.

  • Ability to manage sellers with strongly varying M&A experience and impose price realism while maintaining trust and rapport.

  • Treat your portfolio like a P&L, you know which deals are moving, which are stalling, which to cut, and you make those calls without being asked.

  • Comfort with rapidly evolving processes and new tooling (including AI), with a high-output mindset and consistent delivery of iwoca-grade customer experience.

  • Fluency in UK SME deal structures, Share Purchase Agreement (SPA) terms, and payment mechanisms including earnouts and deferred consideration.

  • Comfortable interfacing with legal counsel, financial buyers, and accounting firms, coordinating between multiple parties through diligence and documentation.

  • Strong commercial instinct when working through incomplete information and maintaining deal velocity across a portfolio.

  • Comfortable being on the phone for hours a day, building trust quickly with business owners and reading emotional signals over the line.

Bonus, but not required:-

  • Experience working with imperfect financial data and owner-managed businesses in the £500k-£10m enterprise value range.

  • Understanding of financial due diligence outputs and how to translate technical findings into actionable seller guidance.

The salary

We expect to pay a base range of £40,000 to £90,000 (OTE: £90K – £240K) for this role, depending on experience and location.

Compensation includes a performance-linked incentive based on a fixed percentage of the transaction fees you generate. With this structure, performers typically earn total compensation between 1.5× and 2.5× base.

We're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Useful links:

  • iwoca benefits & policies

Compensation Range: £40K - £90K

raw.title: Storyous Partnerships & Integrations Manager
raw.excerpt: O roliStoryous pomáhá lokálním podnikům řídit jejich každodenní provoz.
raw.description:
O roli

Storyous pomáhá lokálním podnikům řídit jejich každodenní provoz. K tomu potřebujeme rozvíjet kvalitní spolupráci s technologickými, obchodními a oborovými partnery a zároveň zajistit, aby naše integrace přinášely skutečnou hodnotu zákazníkům i společnosti.

Hledáme člověka, který převezme plnou odpovědnost za dvě propojené oblasti:

  • Integrations: řízení a rozvoj integračního portfolia, spolupráce s technologickými partnery a vedení nových integračních iniciativ od nápadu až po stabilní provoz.

  • Partnerships: vyhledávání, vyjednávání a rozvoj partnerství, která pomohou Storyous oslovit více relevantních zákazníků a rozšířit hodnotu našeho produktu.

Nejde o roli, ve které člověk pouze předává požadavky dál. Budeš vlastníkem výsledku: pochopíš obchodní příležitost, vyhodnotíš její potenciál, navrhneš model spolupráce, vyjednáš podmínky, zajistíš realizaci, prosadíš potřebné změny napříč firmou a následně změříš, zda iniciativa přináší očekávanou hodnotu.

Tvoje mise

Vybudovat a řídit portfolio integrací a partnerství, které:

  • zvyšuje hodnotu Storyous pro zákazníky;

  • podporuje růst obchodních výsledků a akvizici nových zákazníků;

  • vytváří nové distribuční a obchodní příležitosti;

  • zlepšuje produktovou nabídku a uživatelskou zkušenost;

  • má jasný účel, odpovědnost, měřitelné cíle a udržitelný provozní model.

Co budeš dělat

1. Vlastnictví integračního portfolia

  • Převezmeš ownership nad stávajícími i novými integracemi Storyous.

  • Zmapuješ jejich obchodní účel, technický a provozní stav, zapojené týmy, náklady, přínosy a největší rizika.

  • Nastavíš jasný lifecycle integrace od prvotního posouzení přes realizaci a uvedení do provozu až po dlouhodobé vyhodnocování.

  • Budeš hlavním kontaktem pro klíčové technologické partnery.

  • Zajistíš, aby integrace nebyly pouze technicky funkční, ale také srozumitelné, obchodně uchopitelné a dlouhodobě udržitelné.

  • Společně s Product, Engineering a Operations budeš hledat možnosti standardizace, automatizace a zjednodušení podpory.

2. Vyhledávání a rozvoj partnerství

  • Vytvoříš partnerskou strategii v souladu s prioritami Storyous.

  • Budeš aktivně vyhledávat nové příležitosti mezi relevantními firmami, odborníky, distribučními kanály a dalšími subjekty s vazbou na cílový segment.

  • Zmapuješ, kde má partner obchodní motivaci Storyous doporučovat, prodávat, integrovat nebo společně nabízet zákazníkům.

  • Povedeš celý proces od identifikace a kvalifikace partnera přes návrh spolupráce a vyjednávání až po onboarding, launch a další rozvoj.

  • Navrhneš vhodný model spolupráce podle konkrétní příležitosti — například referral, reseller, co-selling, společná nabídka nebo strategická spolupráce.

  • Budeš hledat způsoby, jak partnerské vztahy převést do konkrétního obchodního dopadu, nikoliv pouze do počtu podepsaných smluv.

3. Business case, ekonomika a vyjednávání

  • Pro významné iniciativy připravíš business case založený na dostupných datech a realistických předpokladech.

  • Posoudíš potenciální obchodní přínos, náklady, kapacitu interních týmů, provozní náročnost a hlavní rizika.

  • Budeš navrhovat obchodní podmínky a ekonomický model integrací a partnerství ve spolupráci s relevantními týmy.

  • Povedeš jednání o obchodním modelu, odpovědnostech, podpoře, datových a provozních podmínkách i dalších klíčových tématech.

  • Budeš připravovat rozhodovací materiály pro leadership a umět doporučit, zda iniciativu realizovat, upravit, pilotovat nebo odložit.

4. Product a Engineering enablement

  • Přeložíš obchodní potřebu do jasného produktového a technického zadání.

  • Budeš rozumět principům integrací a produktového vývoje natolik, abys dokázal/a vést kvalifikovanou diskusi s interními i externími technickými stakeholdery.

  • Zajistíš, že požadavky mají jasný účel, rozsah, očekávaný přínos, prioritu a vlastníka.

  • Pokud bude pro realizaci potřeba kapacita Product nebo Engineering, převezmeš odpovědnost za prosazení priority a sladění stakeholderů.

  • Budeš hlídat, aby nové iniciativy měly odpovídající míru standardizace, opakovatelnosti a dlouhodobé udržitelnosti.

  • Zajistíš připravenost onboardingu, dokumentace, podpory, měření výsledků a provozní odpovědnosti před uvedením do provozu.

5. Go-to-market a adoption

  • Ve spolupráci se Sales, Marketingem, Customer Care a Product vytvoříš plán uvedení relevantních integrací a partnerství.

  • Připravíš value proposition, obchodní argumentaci, kvalifikační kritéria a podklady pro interní týmy i partnery.

  • Zajistíš, aby partner rozuměl nabídce Storyous, cílovým zákazníkům a způsobu předávání příležitostí.

  • Budeš sledovat nejen počet aktivovaných partnerů, ale především skutečné využívání a obchodní dopad.

  • Identifikuješ překážky v onboardingovém procesu a budeš je odstraňovat ve spolupráci s interními týmy i partnery.

6. Reporting, governance a kontinuální zlepšování

  • Nastavíš pravidelný reporting portfolia integrací a partnerství pro management.

  • Budeš sledovat vývoj pipeline, obchodní výsledky, aktivaci, využívání, náklady, přínosy a kvalitu provozu.

  • Zavedeš pravidelné business reviews s klíčovými partnery.

  • Budeš udržovat přehlednou evidenci smluv, vlastníků, obchodních podmínek, provozního stavu a dalších klíčových informací.

  • Budeš průběžně vyhodnocovat, které integrace a partnerství rozvíjet, standardizovat, renegociovat nebo ukončit.

Rozhodovací pravomoc a odpovědnost

Od této role očekáváme skutečný ownership, nikoliv pouze koordinaci. Budeš mít odpovědnost za to, aby:

  • každá prioritní iniciativa měla jasný cíl, business case, rozsah a měřítko úspěchu;

  • partnerství byla ekonomicky smysluplná a měla jasně definované odpovědnosti;

  • technické a produktové požadavky byly srozumitelné a měly odpovídající prioritu;

  • interní stakeholderové byli včas informováni a rozhodnutí se dotahovala;

  • problémy byly řešeny přímo a včas, včetně eskalace na správnou úroveň;

  • výsledek byl po uvedení do provozu měřen a případně korigován.

Budeš fungovat jako seniorní individual contributor: bez nutnosti velkého týmu pod sebou, ale s dostatečným vlivem a autoritou pro řízení komplexních iniciativ napříč Commercial, Product, Engineering, Operations, Customer Care, Finance a Legal.

Jak poznáme úspěch

Po 6–12 měsících budeš mít:

  • transparentní přehled integračního portfolia a jasný plán jeho rozvoje;

  • prioritizovaný pipeline nových integrací a partnerství s kvalitními business casy;

  • nové partnerské příležitosti, které generují relevantní obchodní výsledky;

  • zavedený proces od prvotního posouzení po uvedení do provozu a následné měření výsledků;

  • funkční reporting výkonu partnerství a integrací;

  • méně ad-hoc eskalací díky jasným vlastníkům, dokumentaci a provozním procesům;

  • prokazatelný dopad na akvizici zákazníků, revenue, retenci nebo produktovou hodnotu.

Konkrétní cíle a KPI nastavíme podle priorit Storyous v daném období. Mohou zahrnovat zejména:

  • kvalitu a vývoj partnerské pipeline;

  • počet a kvalitu leadů z partnerského kanálu;

  • obchodní výsledky a návratnost vybraných iniciativ;

  • aktivaci a využívání integrací;

  • rychlost uvedení prioritních iniciativ do provozu;

  • kvalitu provozu, podporu a spokojenost zákazníků i partnerů.

Co potřebuješ

Zkušenosti a odborné znalosti

  • Několik let zkušeností v business developmentu, partnerships, B2B sales, product partnerships, platform businessu nebo podobné komplexní roli.

  • Prokazatelnou zkušenost s vedením partnerství od prvního kontaktu až po dlouhodobý provoz.

  • Zkušenost s vyjednáváním obchodních podmínek a schopnost připravit i obhájit business case.

  • Praktickou zkušenost s projektovým řízením a koordinací více týmů bez přímé řídicí pravomoci.

  • Schopnost pracovat s daty, tabulkami a finančními modely.

  • Základní technické porozumění integracím a produktovému vývoji. Nemusíš být developer/ka, ale musíš umět technické téma pochopit, rozebrat a dotáhnout.

  • Zkušenost z fintechu, SaaS, payments, hospitality, retailu nebo podobného prostředí je výhodou.

Osobnost a způsob práce

  • Jsi samostatný/á, iniciativní a umíš si vytvořit vlastní plán práce.

  • Přemýšlíš obchodně, ale rozhoduješ se na základě dat a návratnosti.

  • Umíš být důsledný/á a dostatečně „pushy“, když projekt potřebuje posunout.

  • Dokážeš vést jednání s externím partnerem i interně prosadit potřebné rozhodnutí.

  • Umíš pracovat s nejasností, rozdělit komplexní problém na konkrétní kroky a dotahovat věci do konce.

  • Komunikuješ jasně, věcně a přizpůsobíš styl různým stakeholderům.

  • Nečekáš, až ti někdo předá hotový proces — umíš ho navrhnout, zavést a průběžně zlepšovat.

Jazyky

  • Plynulá čeština nebo slovenština.

  • Dobrá pracovní angličtina pro jednání s partnery a spolupráci v rámci Teya.

Co nabízíme

  • Seniorní roli s reálným vlivem na produkt, obchodní výsledky a další směr Storyous.

  • Možnost vlastnit agendu od strategie a business case až po realizaci a měřitelný výsledek.

  • Spolupráci s Commercial, Product, Engineering a Operations týmy v Česku i v rámci Teya.

  • Hybridní režim práce a flexibilitu.

  • Férovou fixní mzdu a motivující bonusovou složku.

  • 26 dní dovolené a 3 sick days.

  • Interní integrovaný Glean AI k vyhledávání informací v rámci celé společnosti s využitím nejmodernějších LLM

  • Přístup k Elredo audioknihovně

  • BenefitPlus kartu

  • Pravidelné týmové setkání v Praze a prostředí, kde se očekává iniciativa, otevřenost a odpovědnost.

Proč právě Storyous a Teya?

Storyous je součástí Teya — technologického partnera lokálních podniků v Evropě. Naším cílem je zjednodušovat každodenní provoz našich zákazníků prostřednictvím integrovaného softwaru, plateb a služeb, které jim pomáhají růst.

V této roli budeš mít příležitost ovlivnit, s kým Storyous spolupracuje, jaké služby zákazníkům nabídne a jak se tyto služby obchodně i produktově promítnou do našeho řešení. Je to role pro člověka, který nechce pouze spravovat existující vztahy, ale chce vytvořit fungující systém propojující partnerství, integrace a růst merchant base.

Náborový proces

Proces chceme držet rychlý a férový. V jednotlivých kolech se potkáš s lidmi, kteří budou hodnotit zejména:

  • schopnost rozpoznat a vyhodnotit obchodní příležitost;

  • kvalitu uvažování o partnerském a integračním modelu;

  • schopnost vést komplexní iniciativu napříč týmy;

  • způsob vyjednávání a práce s externími stakeholdery;

It’s an outdated, painful, administrative mess.
We’re here to change that.
Our mission is bold: automate 1% of GDP by eliminating the manual, inefficient workflows that plague financial operations in healthcare. We’re building modern systems to replace the legacy software and armies of billing staff that have been the norm for decades.
At ENTER, we believe better financial infrastructure means better healthcare. By using cutting-edge AI and automation, we empower healthcare providers to focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional care, not chasing payments.

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the role

We are looking for a highly innovative, data-driven, and creative Associate Director, who’s motivated by the challenge of working with some of the fastest-growing e-commerce and digital brands. You will lead a team of email, SMS, and retention marketing industry experts to drive client revenue, and partner with internal cross-functional colleagues to go deeper on understanding our customer needs and insights with a specific focus on deepening retention and building loyalty. You will lead a cross-functional team to go deeper building creative strategies in email and SMS campaign development to help our clients grow.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Portugal, Brazil and Spain.

You Should Apply if this sounds like you:

You’re passionate about e-commerce and digital marketing. You’re immersed in the world of direct-to-consumer growth marketing. We're looking for an expert Associate Director, Retention to join our team! In this role, you will lead a growing team within the Retention Marketing Department to strategically develop customized retention (and customer loyalty) marketing strategies that help our clients grow and scale.

  • 7+ years of work experience in digital marketing.

  • You’re passionate about developing creative customer journeys that drive loyalty and lifetime value.

  • You’re passionate about building teams, training them on best practices, and helping them grow into experts.

  • You immerse yourself in scaling personalized D2C/e-commerce email and SMS programs that build deep customer relationships for clients.

  • You have experience working in Klaviyo (or a similar ESP’s) including list segmentation, lifecycle drip automations, and triggered events. Additionally, you have knowledge of Shopify and their tech stack options such as Privy, JustUno, Yotpo, Octane AI etc.

  • You have developed SMS and loyalty programming strategies and have experience working with SMS platforms such as Attentive, PostScript, SMSBump, or Klaviyo.

  • You're used to working in a fast paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.

  • You love making data driven decisions and excel at turning analytics into actionable SMS and email strategies that drive client revenue.

  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.

  • You have experience developing and executing customer loyalty programs that enhance LTV

  • You've had at least one direct report before OR exceptional leadership skills working with cross-functional teams.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

A Day in the Life:

  • Serve as the senior point of contact for select clients, working to develop best-in-class retention strategies. On a weekly basis, you will meet with clients to discuss current and future initiatives.

  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with your direct reports and manage their workload and capacity to ensure their success. Additionally, you will help train the team to help your direct reports succeed and grow.

  • Develop strategic campaign calendars and prioritize projects and initiatives designed to scale your clients’ email and SMS programs.

  • Provide support and guidance to help Retention Specialists analyze data, develop winning retention strategies and create reports for clients happiness.

  • Project manage and delegate client tasks to your team, consisting of both specialists and designers. Review all client briefs and designs for approval before they are sent to the client.

  • Coordinate cross-departmentally with the Performance Marketing and Strategy teams to develop cohesive and creative campaigns that drive client growth.

  • Develop strategic KPI’s for clients and work with the retention team to create insights and actionable recommendations.

  • Execute on automation/flow logic set-up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

What it's like to work at Darkroom:

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

  • Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub): Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

  • Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain.

  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

  • Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Job Title: Global Creative Capability, AI & Innovation Lead

  • Location: Morristown, NJ

About the Job

The AI-Driven Customer Engagement (AICE) team is transforming how Sanofi goes to market by combining human expertise with AI, automation, data, and new ways of working.

The Marketing Transformation & AI Strategy team helps define and build the capabilities required to make this transformation real. This includes identifying and testing emerging technologies, redesigning workflows, developing scalable frameworks, and helping teams adopt new approaches across brands and markets.

As content creation becomes increasingly AI-enabled, visual design must evolve beyond traditional production. Designers need new tools, skills, standards, and operating models that allow them to work more efficiently while continuing to deliver high-quality, differentiated customer experiences.

This role will help shape that evolution—connecting visual design expertise with AI, creative technology, capability building, and organizational change.

The Global Creative Capability, AI & Innovation Lead is responsible for evolving how visual design is enabled and delivered across AICE and the broader marketing organization.

This is a transformation and capability-building role rather than a traditional content-production position. The role will evaluate and advance AI-enabled design tools, improve creative workflows, establish scalable design frameworks, and help visual designers adopt new technologies and ways of working.

A central responsibility will be coaching and developing visual designers across internal teams, distributed pods, and external partners. The role will create practical guidance, learning resources, templates, and communities of practice that enable designers to use emerging technologies effectively while maintaining strong standards for brand consistency, customer experience, accessibility, and quality.

The role will also serve as a subject-matter expert and strategic partner for teams exploring new visual design capabilities. This includes identifying business needs, translating them into capability requirements, testing potential solutions, and helping determine which tools and approaches should be piloted, scaled, integrated, or discontinued.

While the role may occasionally provide hands-on design support to test a new capability, create a proof of concept, or demonstrate a recommended approach, its primary purpose is to enable and elevate the work of others—not to serve as a central production resource.

Success requires deep visual design expertise, curiosity about emerging technology, and the ability to turn experimentation into practical, scalable ways of working. The ideal candidate combines the judgment of an experienced designer with the mindset of a coach, capability builder, and transformation leader.

Join the team transforming how healthcare is delivered for chronic and specialty conditions worldwide. In General Medicines, you’ll help drive meaningful outcomes in diabetes, transplant, and immunology with the scale and urgency patients deserve.

About Sanofi:

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives

Main Responsibilities

Visual Design Capability Strategy

  • Define and evolve the visual design capabilities needed to support Sanofi’s future marketing model.

  • Translate business, customer, and designer needs into clear capability requirements and priorities.

  • Establish scalable visual design principles, frameworks, standards, and recommended ways of working.

  • Help ensure that evolving design capabilities support brand consistency, accessibility, user experience, localization, and channel effectiveness.

  • Advise marketing and transformation leaders on emerging opportunities, capability gaps, and investment priorities related to visual design.

AI, Tools and Creative Technology

  • Identify and evaluate AI-enabled design tools, creative technologies, and emerging capabilities that could improve design quality, speed, scalability, or user experience.

  • Lead or support structured discovery, experimentation, and proof-of-concept work to assess potential business value.

  • Define practical use cases, success criteria, risks, and requirements for new tools and capabilities.

  • Partner with Digital, Technology, Procurement, Legal, Regulatory, and other relevant teams to support responsible evaluation and adoption.

  • Translate successful experimentation into repeatable workflows, guidance, and scalable solutions.

  • Monitor developments in generative AI, design automation, modular content, creative technology, and digital experience design.

Workflow and Operating-Model Transformation

  • Assess current visual design workflows and identify opportunities to simplify, automate, or improve them.

  • Help redesign how visual work is briefed, created, reviewed, adapted, localized, and reused.

  • Develop scalable approaches that allow global and local teams to work effectively across brands, markets, channels, and production partners.

  • Support the development of design systems, modular frameworks, templates, reusable components, and automation opportunities.

  • Partner with operations and transformation colleagues to embed new capabilities into broader content and marketing workflows.

  • Use feedback, adoption insights, and performance data to continuously improve tools and ways of working.

Designer Enablement and Coaching

  • Coach and mentor visual designers across internal teams, global pods, and partner organizations.

  • Help designers build confidence and proficiency in AI-enabled workflows, emerging creative tools, design systems, and modern digital practices.

  • Develop onboarding materials, playbooks, demonstrations, training programs, and practical learning resources.

  • Establish forums and communities of practice that encourage collaboration, knowledge sharing, experimentation, and continuous learning.

  • Provide constructive guidance and expert review when teams are adopting a new tool, workflow, or design approach.

  • Support the recruitment and onboarding of visual design talent where needed, helping ensure that skills and role profiles align with future capability requirements.

Standards, Governance and Quality Enablement

  • Establish clear guardrails for the responsible and effective use of AI within visual design.

  • Develop frameworks that help teams maintain appropriate standards for quality, brand integrity, accessibility, user experience, and regulatory compliance.

  • Create evaluation criteria that allow teams to assess the quality and suitability of AI-generated or AI-assisted visual outputs.

  • Partner with brand, regulatory, legal, and technology stakeholders to address risks and clarify appropriate uses of emerging capabilities.

  • Help teams balance creative experimentation with the standards required in a highly regulated environment.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner closely with Marketing, Content Strategy, Digital, Technology, Operations, brand teams, markets, agencies, and external vendors.

  • Act as the bridge between designers, marketers, technology teams, and business stakeholders when defining or implementing new capabilities.

  • Facilitate working sessions that turn business challenges into practical design and technology solutions.

  • Communicate complex design and technology concepts in a clear, actionable way for both creative and non-creative audiences.

  • Contribute to the broader Marketing Transformation & AI Strategy roadmap and help connect visual design priorities with other transformation initiatives.

About You

Qualifications

  • Degree or equivalent practical experience in graphic design, visual communications, digital design, experience design, creative technology, or a related discipline.

  • 10+ years of experience across visual design, digital experience, creative technology, design systems, creative operations, or related fields.

  • Deep visual design expertise and strong professional judgment, supported by a portfolio demonstrating work across digital channels, formats, and customer experiences.

  • Demonstrated experience building capabilities, developing standards, improving workflows, or leading design transformation—not solely producing individual assets.

  • Strong understanding of AI-enabled creative workflows, generative AI, design automation, modular content systems, and emerging creative technologies.

  • Experience evaluating tools and translating new technology into practical, scalable business applications.

  • Ability to coach, mentor, and develop designers with different levels of experience and technical maturity.

  • Experience creating playbooks, frameworks, training programs, design systems, or reusable approaches that improve the performance of other teams.

  • Strong understanding of digital experience, accessibility, responsive design, channel requirements, and customer-centered design principles.

  • Ability to work across global teams, markets, agencies, vendors, and distributed operating models.

  • Strong facilitation, stakeholder-management, and communication skills.

  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, move between strategy and practical implementation, and manage multiple priorities.

  • Experience in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, or another regulated industry is preferred but not required.

  • Fluency in English is required.

Why Choose Us?

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.

  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.

  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.

  • Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.

  • Help shape the future of care for chronic and complex conditions like aT1D, Type 2 diabetes, transplant, and cardiovascular disease

  • Drive meaningful impact at global scale: our medicines reach more than 100 million people each year.

  • Turn bold ideas into breakthrough launches, with multiple new therapies planned through 2030 and beyond

Job Title

Student Brand Ambassador - Michigan State University

Job Description

If you are a go-getter, involved on your campus, and want to use your skills to help improve student’s lives through education, we are looking for highly motivated Student Brand Ambassadors to join our Kaplan family. In this position, you will increase Kaplan’s visibility on campus, or virtually, through various initiatives and activities, including grassroots marketing, lead generation, relationship building, social media, and more.

The Kaplan Student Ambassador role is a paid position with competitive compensation and incentivized lead and enrollment targets. The hours are flexible based on business needs and ~5 to 15+ hours per week. The position includes a paid training program with the information and tools you need to help you be a successful Student Ambassador.

Primary/Key Responsibilities:

  • Use your existing connections to build and strengthen Kaplan relationships with student organizations

  • Generate leads through a variety of on-campus initiatives and social media efforts, including club meetings, Kaplan events, and social media sharing

  • Execute grassroots marketing initiatives, including on-campus tables, fairs, flyers, and more

  • Develop new relationships, and establish partnerships, with influential student groups and organizations

  • Present to students on campus to share how Kaplan’s products and resources will help them achieve their goals

  • Create and share content through personal social media channels to engage students with the Kaplan brand and experience

  • Use your knowledge and expertise of your campus to bring Kaplan to relevant campus activities and initiatives

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify on-campus event opportunities (including school fairs, club/organization meetings)

  • Support students who are ready to enroll in a course by connecting them with the appropriate test prep advisor

Education and Experience:

  • Level of Education: Current sophomore, junior, or senior on campus

  • Skills:

    • Engaged in your campus community or an active member or leader of a student club or organization

    • Active on social media with an engaged audience and strong digital presence

    • Skilled in finding relevant student groups and fostering those relationships

    • Creative problem solver with excellent communication skills

    • Able to manage multiple initiatives while working independently and remotely

  • Personal Attributes:

    • Able to work in a virtual role while staying active, engaged, and responsive with your manager

    • Must be a proactive, self-starter and motivated with excellent time management skills

    • High energy with a get-it-done attitude

Individuals hired for KNA positions that require in-person work and/or travel must be fully vaccinated against COVID-19 unless otherwise prohibited by law. KNA complies with federal, state, and local laws with regard to accommodations related to this policy.

Kaplan is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All positions with Kaplan are paid at least $15 per hour or $31,200 per year for full-time positions. Compensation for specific positions are based on job level, skills, years of experience, and education, among other factors. Additionally, certain positions are bonus or commission eligible. Information regarding benefits can be found here.

At Kaplan, we believe in attracting, rewarding, and retaining exceptional talent. Our compensation philosophy is designed to be competitive within the market, reflecting the value we place on the skills, experience, and contributions of our employees, while taking into account labor market trends and total rewards.

Location

East Lansing, MI, USA

Additional Locations

Remote/Nationwide, USA

Employee Type

Employee

Job Functional Area

Branding

Business Unit

00091 Kaplan Higher ED

Diversity & Inclusion Statement:

Kaplan is committed to cultivating an inclusive workplace that values diversity, promotes equity, and integrates inclusivity into all aspects of our operations. We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, veteran status, nationality, or sex. We believe that diversity strengthens our organization, fuels innovation, and improves our ability to serve our students, customers, and communities. Learn more about our culturehere.

Kaplan considers qualified applicants for employment even if applicants have an arrest or conviction in their background check records. Kaplan complies with related background check regulations, including but not limited to, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. There are various positions where certain convictions may disqualify applicants, such as those positions requiring interaction with minors, financial records, or other sensitive and/or confidential information.

Kaplan is a drug-free workplace and complies with applicable laws.

raw.excerpt: A SolarGrid atua no mercado de energia renovável, com soluções voltadas à Geração Distribuída (GD) e à redução de custos com energia para empresas.
raw.description:
A SolarGrid atua no mercado de energia renovável, com soluções voltadas à Geração Distribuída (GD) e à redução de custos com energia para empresas.

Estamos ampliando nossa rede de relacionamento comercial e buscamos parceiros comerciais independentesinteressados em identificar e desenvolver oportunidades de novos negócios junto a empresas consumidoras de energia.

Sobre a parceria

Esta oportunidade refere-se a uma parceria comercial independente e não a uma vaga de emprego.

Buscamos profissionais ou empresas que desejem atuar de forma autônoma e independente, utilizando sua rede de relacionamentos, experiência comercial e capacidade de prospecção para conectar potenciais clientes à SolarGrid.

A remuneração será exclusivamente vinculada ao sucesso dos negócios efetivamente convertidos, conforme as condições comerciais estabelecidas para a parceria.

O parceiro terá liberdade para organizar sua própria atuação comercial, sem exclusividade, jornada predeterminada ou subordinação hierárquica.

É uma oportunidade especialmente interessante para profissionais que já possuem relacionamento com empresas e decisores e desejam transformar esse networking em uma fonte adicional de receita.

A SolarGrid dará suporte ao parceiro com informações comerciais, materiais de apresentação e apoio técnico e comercial necessário para o desenvolvimento das oportunidades.

Mais do que um vendedor tradicional, buscamos pessoas que consigam abrir portas.

Profissionais que conheçam empresários e decisores, tenham credibilidade junto à sua rede de relacionamentos e consigam identificar empresas para as quais uma solução de redução de custos com energia possa gerar valor econômico relevante.

O objetivo é construir uma rede qualificada de parceiros comerciais independentes da SolarGrid, capaz de gerar oportunidades de negócio de forma descentralizada, escalável e baseada em resultado.O parceiro poderá:

  • Identificar empresas com potencial de contratação das soluções oferecidas pela SolarGrid;
  • Utilizar sua rede de contatos e relacionamento profissional para gerar novas oportunidades comerciais;
  • Prospectar potenciais clientes por meio de relacionamento próprio, telefone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, e-mail, eventos ou outros canais;
  • Identificar e acessar decisores e influenciadores dentro das empresas;
  • Realizar a abordagem inicial e identificar o interesse e o potencial do cliente;
  • Apresentar a oportunidade e conectar o potencial cliente à equipe comercial da SolarGrid;
  • Quando fizer sentido, participar de reuniões e apoiar o desenvolvimento da oportunidade comercial;
  • Auxiliar na construção do relacionamento com o cliente durante o processo de negociação;
  • Gerar novas oportunidades de negócio de forma recorrente.
Procuramos pessoas com:

  • Experiência ou forte relacionamento no mercado B2B;
  • Capacidade de acessar empreendedores (pequeno e médio porte), empresários, executivos, diretores, gestores financeiros, gestores de facilities, responsáveis por energia ou outros tomadores de decisão;
  • Perfil empreendedor, comercial e orientado a resultados;
  • Facilidade para desenvolver relacionamentos e identificar oportunidades de negócio;
  • Credibilidade e boa capacidade de interlocução com empresas;
  • Autonomia para desenvolver sua própria estratégia de geração de negócios.
  • Não é necessário que a pessoa esteja buscando uma nova posição profissional.
  • Pelo contrário: podem ser excelentes parceiros profissionais que já atuem como empresários, consultores, representantes comerciais, assessores, executivos independentes ou prestadores de serviços e que possuam relacionamento com potenciais clientes da SolarGrid.

Podem ter excelente aderência à parceria:

  • Consultores empresariais;
  • Consultores de energia;
  • Representantes comerciais independentes;
  • Profissionais de desenvolvimento de negócios;
  • Consultores financeiros;
  • Contadores e empresas de contabilidade;
  • Consultores tributários;
  • Corretores e consultores imobiliários com atuação empresarial;
  • Empresas de facilities e serviços corporativos;
  • Integradores e profissionais ligados ao setor de energia;
  • Profissionais dos setores de infraestrutura, indústria, logística, varejo, agronegócio e serviços;
  • Ex-executivos com amplo relacionamento empresarial;
  • Empresários e profissionais com forte networking regional;
  • Pessoas que já atuem comercialmente junto a empresas consumidoras de energia.

Serão especialmente valorizados parceiros que possuam:
  • Carteira de relacionamento com empresas;
  • Acesso direto a empreendedores, empresários, CFOs, CEOs, diretores financeiros, gestores de energia ou responsáveis por facilities;
  • Experiência nos setores de energia, utilities, sustentabilidade, infraestrutura ou serviços B2B;
  • Experiência em vendas consultivas;
  • Atuação junto a empresas com consumo relevante de energia;
  • Forte presença comercial ou institucional em determinada região ou segmento econômico.


Informações adicionais

A relação será estabelecida por meio de parceria comercial independente, sem exclusividade e sem vínculo empregatício.

O parceiro poderá manter normalmente suas demais atividades profissionais e comerciais.

A remuneração será baseada exclusivamente no êxito comercial, de acordo com os negócios originados pelo parceiro e efetivamente convertidos em clientes, conforme regras previamente estabelecidas entre as partes.

raw.title: Remote Senior Engineer (L3)
raw.excerpt: Job Summary:We are seeking a Remote Senior IT Engineer (L3) to join our Service and Support team and take ownership of advanced technical escalations from assignment through resolution.
raw.description:
Job Summary:

We are seeking a Remote Senior IT Engineer (L3) to join our Service and Support team and take ownership of advanced technical escalations from assignment through resolution. This role requires a highly experienced engineer with at least 5 years of hands-on technical experience and strong expertise across networking, server, cloud, and infrastructure technologies. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator who can confidently guide clients through complex technical issues, work independently, think critically, and troubleshoot across multiple systems in a fast-paced MSP environment. The role supports environments involving Microsoft Server, Active Directory, Exchange, SQL, Microsoft 365, Azure/Entra, virtualization, networking, wireless, VPNs, firewalls, backups, Linux, UNIX, and related technologies. The position may occasionally require after-hours and on-call support for urgent escalations and client-impacting issues.

Key Responsibilities:

L3 Technical Support

  • Own escalated L3 technical tickets from assignment through complete resolution.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues that L1/L2 technicians are unable to resolve.
  • Diagnose and resolve issues across multiple systems, technologies, and client environments.
  • Work independently while knowing when to seek additional technical expertise.

Servers & Microsoft Technologies

  • Install, configure, administer, and troubleshoot Windows Server environments.
  • Support Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, authentication, domains, users, groups, and file permissions.
  • Install, configure, administer, and troubleshoot Microsoft Exchange and enterprise email environments.
  • Support Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and related services.
  • Support Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Intune, and cloud identity management.

Networking & Infrastructure

  • Configure and troubleshoot TCP/IP, subnetting, VLANs, routing, VPNs, DNS, firewalls, and wireless networks.
  • Troubleshoot Internet connectivity and determine whether issues originate from workstations, servers, networks, firewalls, ISPs, DNS, routing, VPNs, or wireless infrastructure.
  • Support Fortinet and UniFi network infrastructure.
  • Support routers, switches, patch panels, and network-connected devices.

Cloud, Virtualization & Datacenter

  • Support Microsoft Azure and/or Amazon AWS environments.
  • Support Hyper-V, VMware, Citrix, and other virtualization technologies.
  • Troubleshoot virtualization hosts, storage, networking, snapshots, and virtual machine performance.
  • Support SQL Server, SQL clustering, enterprise backup systems, and Veeam Backup & Replication.
  • Support SAN architecture, high-availability solutions, load balancing, and Exchange clustering.

Security, Documentation & Client Service

  • Support endpoint security, MFA, EDR/XDR, managed security platforms, and related security technologies.
  • Read, understand, and safely execute basic PowerShell and command-line scripts.
  • Maintain thorough documentation of troubleshooting steps, client communications, actions taken, root causes, and resolutions.
  • Update client documentation when information is missing, outdated, or reusable.
  • Communicate clearly with clients, Account Managers, team leadership, end users, IT personnel, and C-level executives.
  • Provide accurate next steps, ETAs, and time estimates.
  • Identify recurring issues and help reduce repeat escalations.
  • Participate in ongoing technical training and after-hours/on-call support as required.
  • Perform other duties related to the position as assigned.

Qualifications & Requirements:

Experience & Technical Expertise

  • Minimum 5 years of professional engineering or equivalent technical experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience supporting Active Directory, Microsoft Windows, Windows Server, and Microsoft 365.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience supporting network switching, VLANs, routing, firewalls, and VPNs.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience supporting data backup and recovery, endpoint security, and VPN connectivity.
  • Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex, client-facing technical issues.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Windows, Windows Server, Active Directory, Exchange, and Microsoft 365.
  • Strong networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching, VPNs, DNS, firewalls, and wireless technologies.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and/or Amazon AWS.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, and cloud identity management.
  • Working knowledge of SQL Server, Veeam Backup & Replication, Hyper-V, VMware, and other virtualization technologies.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise wireless technologies, including SSID management, WPA2/WPA3, VLAN integration, and RADIUS authentication.
  • Working knowledge of security fundamentals, including endpoint protection, MFA, EDR/XDR, SOC, managed security platforms, phishing, and threat management.
  • Ability to read, understand, and safely execute basic PowerShell and command-line scripts.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MSP experience and experience supporting multiple clients or multi-client environments.
  • Fortinet firewall experience.
  • UniFi network experience.
  • Microsoft Intune experience.
  • Citrix experience.
  • Experience with ConnectWise Manage, IT Glue, and N-central.
  • Microsoft 365, Microsoft Azure, Fortinet, VMware VCP, A+, Network+, Security+, or other relevant industry certifications.

Professional Skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently with limited supervision.
  • Ability to manage multiple technical issues in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
  • Strong customer-service orientation and ability to communicate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to remain professional and effective in stressful situations.
  • Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and teamwork.
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies through self-study and hands-on experience.

Remote Work Requirements

  • Proficient level of English, written and spoken.
  • Ability to work U.S. Eastern Time (New York) business hours and adapt to business needs.
  • Reliable computer running Windows 10 or newer.
  • Two monitors and stable high-speed Internet.
  • Professional home workstation capable of supporting uninterrupted remote work.
  • Ability to work independently and follow established processes.
  • Self-motivated, dependable, coachable, and accountable.
  • Interested in a long-term career opportunity.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • 100% remote work.
  • Compensation in USD.
  • Full-time position with 40 hours weekly.
  • Please note that this is a long-term opportunity.
  • Great work environment with potential for growth.

Make an impact. Change lives. Live a Legacy.

Manage Revenue Cycle personnel and processes across Patient Access and Customer Service to maximize productivity, accuracy, revenue collections, and customer satisfaction. Leverage AI and automation to streamline workflows, develop SOPs supporting best practices, build and employ daily analytics for proactive management, harness healthcare technology to achieve business goals, and foster a team culture built on positivity, accountability, collaboration, and mutual respect, with a commitment to celebrating wins.

• Work closely with leadership on all Revenue Cycle initiatives and apprise of any major issue which may affect service, productivity, or revenue. • Hire, train, support, monitor, coach, and evaluate Revenue Cycle personnel, focusing on maximized output/accuracy, prompt issue resolution, goal achievement, collaboration, and positive team culture.• Maintain and develop SOP’s and reference/training manuals as needed to support best practices and peak performance.• Utilize KPI’s and analytics daily to proactively manage individual and team performance and identify areas for improvement.• Serve as Subject Matter Expert and assist Revenue Cycle, corporate, clinical staff and leadership with questions and concerns that may arise.• Act as escalation point for internal and customer complaints, resolving problems quickly and completely, with an eye towards process improvement.• Develop strong relationships with technology partners and outsourced vendors, employing their offerings in optimal and cost-effective ways.• Leverage AI and automation to maximize efficiency and productivity.• Acts as administrator for RCM software, payer portals, and applications.• Manage staff and processes to maximize efficiency and accuracy of patient profile setup, insurance eligibility, benefit verification, submission of prior authorizations, and provider referral requests, also minimizing related write offs due to errors. • Maintain knowledge of pertinent payer guidelines and legislative changes to proactively oversee and implement necessary processes updates, to avoid unnecessary patient access delays and service issues.• Analyze and address root cause of all write offs related to patient access and customer service issues, providing education and feedback as necessary to minimize those amounts. • Responsible for ensuring all patient payments are identified and posted accurately and timely into the patient accounting system.• Maintain the accuracy and consistency of patient statements, concentrating on a broadly electronic delivery system for all bills.• Manage the patient copay, payment plan, automated credit card, and patient overpayments processes.• Oversee the successful collections and bad debt write off of outstanding patient balances, maximizing receipts and minimizing days in AR.• Monitor Call Tower metrics to ensure all customer service deliverables are being met and patient satisfaction is maximized.• Other duties as assigned.

Your Legacy career offers great experiences, work/life balance, and excellent rewards, including:

  • Desirable Monday—Friday schedule with no weekend or holiday requirements
  • 401(k)
  • Medical/dental/vision/prescription/pet insurance for part time/full time employees
  • Paid time off (PTO) with rollover and buyout options at year’s end for part time/full time employees
  • Company-paid group life
  • Flex spending account
  • Voluntary life, short-term disability, and long-term disability insurance
  • Licensure reimbursement for part time/full time employees
  • Company-provided CEUs and unlimited online CEUs for full-time employees
  • Career advancement opportunities

Discover what makes Legacy Healthcare Services different:

  • Our not-for-profit organization offers personalized therapeutic care for residents within senior living communities, offering rehabilitative care that helps improve their quality of life.
  • Our organization was founded by and continues to be led by therapists.
  • We are one of the largest providers of on-site senior therapy care in the country, serving nearly 500 senior living communities throughout the U.S. and growing!
  • We are leaders in innovation and personalized care, which makes us a preferred provider for senior adults residing in the communities we serve.

Position requirements:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, personal/professional qualities, and skills/abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.• Bachelor's degree preferred, with 7+ years of experience in Revenue Cycle Management required. • 3+ years management of customer service and patient access management required, preferably with remote supervision experience.• 3+ years of experience implementing, developing and supporting practice management and EHR systems, healthcare applications, and clearinghouses (preferably Waystar) required.• Deep knowledge and understanding of Medicare, Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, and commercial insurance plans, with capability to stay current on payer guidelines.• Solid understanding of HIPAA, Fair Debt Collection Practices Act, and No Surprises Act, with ability to stay current on all pertinent governmental legislation.• Must be organized, flexible, and detail oriented with capacity to successfully manage competing priorities. • Professional demeanor and appearance with expertise in deescalating rising concerns and motivating self and others to accomplish desired results.• Exceptional oral and written communication skills are required.

Pay Range

USD $70,000.00 - USD $75,000.00 /Yr.

raw.description:
Meet Domaine, the world's largest independent Shopify design and development partner, formed by the union of Half Helix and Tomorrow. We are a team of commerce experts dedicated to creating, building, and growing beloved brands. As pioneers and not just participants in our industry, we are inspired to write, break, and re-write the rules for a new generation of commerce.

Domaine is looking for a motivated team member that has a passion for eCommerce who wants to grow with our agency to develop into an industry leader in the space. The Project Manager is a key leader within the project management team, responsible for overseeing complex projects, mentoring team members, and supporting strategic department initiatives. This role requires deep expertise in ecommerce, particularly within the Shopify ecosystem, and the ability to independently manage high-stakes projects while maintaining strong client relationships. The Project Manager is also expected to contribute to internal process improvements, develop functional specifications, and ensure that project teams operate efficiently and effectively.

TRAITS

  • Strategic thinker with a visionary approach, able to see the bigger picture while managing the details.
  • Confident and assertive in decision-making, with the ability to lead high-stakes projects and guide teams through complex challenges.
  • Resilient and calm under pressure, capable of managing multiple priorities and tight deadlines without compromising quality.
  • Inspirational mentor and leader, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and excellence within the team.
  • Highly analytical with a data-driven mindset, using insights to inform decisions and optimize project outcomes.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Project Leadership:

  • Independently manage and lead multiple complex projects from inception to completion, ensuring that they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.
  • Maintain a high level of billable time (80%) while overseeing project teams and ensuring efficient resource utilization.
  • Act as a proactive consultant, identifying opportunities for project savings, optimizing timelines, and managing changes to project scope.
  • Expertly manage project dependencies, critical paths, and workback plans, ensuring that risks are identified, documented, and mitigated.

Client Relations:

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, expertly handling challenging communications and maintaining strong, long-term relationships.
  • Identify and lead opportunities to expand client relationships, resulting in additional billable work.
  • Communicate complex requirements and project changes to clients with clarity and professionalism, ensuring alignment on goals and expectations.

Finance Operations Manager

Join a pioneering team shaping the future of finance operations.

Project Y is recruiting skilled finance professionals to support international companies in the US and Europe. In this role, you’ll work with modern finance processes, AI-driven workflows, and automation tools while contributing to meaningful business outcomes.

This position is ideal for finance professionals seeking to move beyond traditional transactional tasks and work at the intersection of finance, technology, and global business.

Location: South Africa (Remote)

About Project Y

Project Y is the premier partner for international companies hiring dedicated Finance Operations Specialists from South Africa.

We partner with fast-growing companies in the United States and Europe to support their finance operations, embedding highly skilled Finance and Operations specialists and supporting those with a centralized AI-enabled approach to improve workflows, tooling, and process outcomes.

About the Role

We’re developing a new approach to finance operations.

This is not a traditional accounting-only role. It is not a bookkeeping-only position. It is not a purely strategic finance advisory role.

This role sits within modern finance operations, where accounting execution, financial reporting, process ownership, and system accuracy come together.

You will be employed through Project Y as the Employer of Record and work remotely with selected international companies (primarily in the US and Europe), supporting their day-to-day financial operations across multiple entities and systems.

You will also be supported by AI-enabled tools and workflow automation, allowing you to focus on higher-value finance operations.

This is an opportunity to gain experience operating in global finance environments while developing operational and technology-enabled finance skills.

Company introduction:

Compass Pathways plc (Nasdaq: CMPS) is a biotechnology company dedicated to unlocking urgently needed new treatment options in mental health care.

The Company is headquartered in London, UK, with a U.S. office in New Jersey. We believe mental health patients deserve the possibility of a better future. Our initial focus is developing COMP360 psilocybin, a proprietary, investigational, synthetic psilocybin treatment under evaluation for treatment-resistant depression (TRD) and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). COMP360 is a potentially first-in-class treatment and has Breakthrough Therapy designation from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), as well as Innovative Licensing and Access Pathway (ILAP) designation in the UK for TRD.

We are leading the world’s largest classic psychedelic clinical program in TRD, and building upon that robust foundation, we are executing a late-stage trial evaluating COMP360 for PTSD, another condition with high unmet need. Our goal is to advance treatments that move the field of psychiatry towards treatment options that offer rapid onset and sustained durability with infrequent dosing. -Compass Pathways

Job overview:

The Associate Director, Scientific Communications will help to optimize and execute the Scientific Communications function within Medical Affairs, stewarding the capabilities, processes, and scientific communications that support launch readiness and future growth. This individual will translate emerging clinical and scientific evidence into clear, compelling, and scientifically rigorous communications that advance Medical Affairs strategy and scientific exchange.

Success in this role requires equal parts strategic thinking and hands-on execution. Working closely with the Executive Director of Medical Affairs, the Associate Director will help shape scientific communications strategy while personally owning key deliverables, including publications, congress materials, scientific platforms, slide decks, FAQs, and medical education resources. The role requires a balance of strategic thinking and practical execution, partnering across Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, HEOR, Regulatory, Legal, Compliance, and Field Medical to continuously improve publication planning, congress planning, and scientific communications processes that enable timely, consistent, and impactful dissemination of scientific evidence.

We are seeking a scientifically rigorous, intellectually curious, and creative team player who is energized by the opportunity to build something new. The ideal candidate enjoys solving complex challenges, values diverse perspectives, and combines scientific excellence with thoughtful design to create engaging, high-impact scientific communications that ultimately improve patient care.

Location:Remote in the United States.

Reports to:Executive Director, Medical Affairs.

Roles and responsibilities(Includes but not limited to):

Stewardship of the Scientific Communications Function

  • Drive the defined Scientific Communications plans within Medical Affairs, contributing to scalable processes and capabilities to support launch and long-term growth
  • Partner with Medical Affairs leadership to develop and execute an integrated Scientific Communications strategy aligned with organizational priorities
  • Identify opportunities to improve how scientific information is communicated by introducing thoughtful, innovative approaches that enhance clarity, quality, and impact
  • Vendor selection and management, and engagement with external thought leader collaborators

Publications Planning and Scientific Dissemination

  • Lead publication planning and execution across the Medical Affairs portfolio, ensuring timely and effective dissemination of scientific evidence
  • Refine and continuously improve publication planning processes, governance, and execution in collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders
  • Partner with internal subject matter experts, Clinical Development, and external authors to develop manuscripts, abstracts, posters, and oral presentations in accordance with compliance policies
  • Monitor publication timelines and proactively identify risks, opportunities, and dependencies

Congress Scientific Planning and Execution

  • Lead scientific planning for key medical congresses in partnership with cross-functional teams
  • Coordinate congress scientific communications with publication plans and organizational priorities
  • Support the development of abstracts, posters, presentations, and related scientific content
  • Ensure congress activities maximize scientific engagement and effective dissemination of new evidence

High-Impact Scientific Communications

  • Collaborate closely with the Field Medical organization to develop high-quality scientific communications that support scientific exchange
  • Develop and maintain scientific slide decks, FAQs, educational resources, advisory board materials, presentations, and other Medical Affairs communications
  • Translate complex scientific and clinical data into accurate, engaging communications tailored to diverse scientific audiences
  • Ensure scientific consistency across Medical Affairs communications through thoughtful review and content stewardship

Scientific Communication Platforms

  • Own and continuously evolve the Treatment-Resistant Depression Scientific Communications Platform as the scientific foundation for Medical Affairs communications
  • Partner with internal scientific leaders to develop and maintain the PTSD Scientific Communications Platform
  • Ensure emerging scientific evidence is appropriately integrated into communication platforms and core Medical Affairs materials

Candidate Profile:

  • Advanced scientific degree (PharmD, PhD, MD, DO, PsyD, or equivalent) in a relevant scientific discipline
  • Minimum 8 years experience in Medical Affairs, Scientific Communications, Publications, or a related function within the biopharmaceutical industry and/or scientific/medical communications agency
  • Demonstrated experience leading publication planning and execution, including manuscripts, abstracts, posters, and scientific presentations
  • Experience supporting scientific communications for major medical congresses
  • Exceptional scientific writing, editing, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear and compelling scientific communications
  • Prior leadership experience in Scientific Communications is strongly preferred with demonstrated success managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience in psychiatry, neuroscience, or other CNS therapeutic areas strongly preferred
  • Launch or pre-commercial experience is highly desirable
  • Intellectually curious and enjoys solving complex scientific and operational challenges
  • Highly collaborative, seeking diverse perspectives, while maintaining the confidence to make decisions and move work forward
