Position SummaryThe Clinical Program Manager - Case Management leads strategic initiatives for the Generations Advantage and USFHP lines of business. In this role, you will design, implement, and oversee targeted programs aimed at improving care transitions, reducing avoidable readmissions, and enhancing post-discharge follow-up, while ensuring strict compliance with regulatory requirements. Additionally, you will champion our integrated, whole-person care model by optimizing workflows and operational reporting. Acting as a key resource across the organization, you will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to align clinical strategies with operational excellence and ongoing program success.


Job Description

PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Supports program development activities, including operational reporting and program resources
  • Translates organizational strategy into actionable, localized case management work plans
  • Streamlines case management workflows to eliminate clinical inefficiencies and improve member engagement
  • Optimizes data reporting structures to track program metrics, identifying trends that require clinical interventions
  • Monitors program benchmarks and key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the success of CM Program
  • Ensures all clinical initiatives comply with TriCare, CMS, NCQA, and other state or federal regulatory standards
  • Identifies trends, gaps and operational risks through performance monitoring
  • Develops presentations, communication, and program tools in support of CM Program
  • Partners with cross-functional leaders to align care model and implement new program initiatives
  • Facilitates committees and working groups to communicate program updates, barriers, and financial outcomes
  • Collaborates with IT and analytics teams to refine case management software platforms and reporting dashboards and scorecards.

Employees are expected to work consistently to demonstrate the mission, vision, and core values of the organization.

raw.description:
If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

Specialist Underwriter - Planning Unit Operations (PUO)

Portfolio Underwriting & Optimization is a specialized department within the Contract Property & Casualty underwriting organization. The PUO team is responsible for driving profitable growth through strategic book management by applying technical underwriting expertise and various data driven analysis with the goal to identify and deliver underwriting actions that align with business strategy.

General responsibilities for a PUO underwriter include the following:

  • Management/assisting of assigned LOB/segment and identifies, coordinates, and delivers on product, appetite, and pricing optimization changes to the portfolio
  • Ensuring rate strategy implementation and execution for assigned LOB/segment
  • Utilize data tools, reporting and external resources and publications to identify trends and make recommendations to improve profitability
  • Collaborate with underwriting and agency partners to solicit feedback on new product and program opportunities
  • Collaborate with Product and technology partners to drive successful implementation of product enhancements in underwriting systems and ensure system behavior supports underwriting intent
  • Collaborate with Product on the design and development of new forms and standalone product/program offerings
  • Provide recommendations for future audits based on existing portfolio trends or retrospective portfolio reviews
  • Participate in claims roundtables, agency visits/agency calls to proactively identify, research and solution for trends/opportunities in assigned segment(s)
  • Attending industry conferences and events
  • Assist/manage Alternative Distribution book as needed.

The candidate for this role should have 6 years related experience or 5 years as an Underwriter and should have prior experience in Commercial P&C Excess & Surplus lines underwriting with:

  • Commercial E&S P&C underwriting and product knowledge
  • Ability to identify, manage and solution for trends within a book of business
  • Understanding of underwriting operations and underwriting systems
  • Familiarity with ISO and other industry resources
  • Data analysis and identifying an impact on book performance
  • Manage projects and prioritize multiple tasks under tight deadlines
  • Be a self-starter who takes initiative to improve quality, processes, and communication
  • Be a proficient communicator and have the skills and ability to explain a complex concept to a broad audience
  • Effective in managing ambiguity with the ability to operate under limited direction
  • Have strong rapport with other departments and collaborate with them on project work
  • Accountable for performance of subset/segment of larger vertical

*This role does not qualify for employer-sponsored work authorization. Nationwide does not participate in the Stem OPT Extension program.*

Job Description Summary

Are you a critical thinker who can analyze complex risk and find insurance solutions that balance customer needs with business goals? If you can take initiative, use both your analytical and creative abilities to make sound decisions and have a desire to help people solve real challenges, we want to hear from you!

Our Excess & Surplus/Specialty (E&S/S) lines allow us to provide insurance that other carriers may not offer. It’s a fast-paced environment in a collaborative, team-oriented culture, working in an always-changing, growing industry.

As an Underwriting Specialist in Contract you determine individual risk acceptability, pricing, coverage, terms and conditions, by developing, analyzing and evaluating information and exposures on risks of a complex technical nature for the assigned line of business. In addition, you’ll achieve production and loss ratio goals with assigned general agents or program managers by reviewing and analyzing claims, loss history and taking appropriate action on accounts. General agent assignments are more complex in terms of coverage and general agent relationships. It’s important to establish and maintain effective relationships with general agents to generate premium dollars and profitability. You will work independently with a high level of authority and judgment. Determining appropriate reinsurance placement, if any, on individual accounts is an important element of this role. We will count on you to foster positive business relationships with co-workers, general agents and reinsurers. You will also assist with research, development and presentation of new products, forms and manuals and have opportunities to assist in the training and mentoring of Underwriters and Underwriting Assistants.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Reviews individual risks with assigned agents or programs within assigned territory and either declines or accepts business based upon information necessary to make the decision. The underwriter analyzes, with a high level of technical expertise, exposures to loss, develops an adequate premium charge for the exposure and determines appropriate endorsements and exclusions to address loss exposures for the insurance contract. Within department guidelines, places reinsurance, if any, for the account.

  • Achieves individual production and loss ratio goals within assigned territory through sound territory management and marketing. Achieves production, profitability and service objectives. Quotes, prices and underwrites new and renewal policies and endorsements, primarily for complex or service sensitive accounts. Monitors risk selection and pricing decisions for entire agency plant, both on a book of business and individual account level basis. Works with more complex issues concerning coverage, programs, agents and program managers. The underwriter continually analyzes premium and loss results in their territory or assigned agents by agency, state, major class of business and by program. Continually assess quality of submissions and makes corrective action recommendations. Development and implementation of specific action plans may be required

  • Handles policy maintenance items and other mid-term requests. Reviews endorsement requests and processes necessary changes to the policy. Reviews loss control reports and makes recommendations to the agent and/or changes to the policy. Follows up on outstanding information as required. Reviews claim activity and takes appropriate action. May review agency books of business as well as profit/growth results and trends to recommend and implement action plans.

  • Fosters positive business relationships with general agents through daily contact with assigned agents by developing and maintaining good rapport and resolving agency conflicts. Travels to agency offices as required for audits, training or marketing visits. Entertains agents visiting the Company as required. Assists with development of marketing ideas and strategies for underwriting seminars and other marketing campaigns.

  • Places reinsurance per department guidelines based upon the appropriate use of all reinsurance facilities used by the department, including various treaty semiautomatic and facultative reinsurance. Maintains good working relationship with reinsurers.

  • Markets Nationwide products and services to help drive agency and company results, including all enterprise products that may enhance offerings. Assists agency with strategies for pipeline management, producer development and to develop new business in targeted industries and preferred markets. Responds effectively to assess accounts and develop business propositions that win the business.

  • Other responsibilities as assigned may include program research and development, form development, rate development, technical assistance to Agents, Underwriting Assistants, and other Underwriters. Proactively develops technical and business knowledge through internal and external venues

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Department Manager

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Undergraduate degree preferred. Equivalent work experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.

License/Certification/Designation: Completion of general insurance courses such as CPCU, CIC, AU, ARM, CPIW, CWIS, or ASLI is preferred.

Experience: Six years related experience or five years as an underwriter, excess & surplus lines preferred.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Knowledge of lines underwriting policies, practices and procedures, insurance law and underwriting marketing principles and techniques, rating plans and plan concepts, Treaty & Facultative reinsurance concepts, general agency system and company operations, regulatory issues, the general agency system, market conditions and company operations. Ability to communicate effectively, orally, and in writing, interpersonally with individuals and groups via telephone, fax, e-mail and in person. Demonstrates advanced negotiation skills. Ability to manage the assigned line or lines of business, which may include monitoring of aggregates. Ability to work with the wholesale/general agency distribution system. Ability to analyze insurance risks to determine acceptability including policy language, various commercial rating plans and methodologies, reinsurance. Ability to use/learn job related computer software. Ability to devise business solutions to problems, implement the most appropriate, and monitor its effectiveness. Ability to make decisions with minimal supervision.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and HR Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Not Eligible (Exempt)

Working Conditions: Normal office environment. Travel out of state as required several times a year. In-town entertaining required as necessary after 5:00 P.M.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de CRM de Dados para fortalecer nossa área e apoiar a tomada de decisões estratégicas. Esse(a) profissional será responsável por transformar dados em insights acionáveis, sempre colocando a cliente em primeiro lugar, garantindo a confiabilidade das informações e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de estratégias de CRM cada vez mais assertivas.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Criar Dashboards interativos, relatórios e análises no Power BI e Looker Studio;
  • Modelagem de Dados – Desenvolver e implementar modelos analíticos para sustentação e apoio a tomada de decisão, garantindo sua confiabilidade e utilizando técnicas de modelagem multidimensional e de desnormalização de dados;
  • Desenvolver análises da base de clientes (criando segmentações, identificando padrões de comportamento, entre outros);
  • Coletar, limpar e integrar dados de várias fontes para garantir a qualidade e a consistência dos conjuntos de dados;
  • Realizar análises exploratórias de dados para identificar tendências, padrões e insights relevantes;
  • Interpretar e comunicar os resultados das análises de forma clara e concisa para partes interessadas internas e externas;
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender as necessidades de dados e fornecer soluções analíticas eficazes;
  • Fornecer suporte na implementação e manutenção de sistemas e ferramentas de análise de dados;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências e avanços na área de análise de dados, contribuindo para a inovação contínua;
  • Apresentar análises, relatórios e Dashboards em reuniões estratégicas;
  • Atuar em parceria com os demais membros da equipe para entender a relação entre as ações de CRM desenvolvidas e os resultados alcançados.
  • Ensino Superior completo ou cursando: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática, Economia, Marketing ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Banco de Dados: Conhecimento em SQL e experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (ex: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB);
  • Ferramentas de BI: Domínio de ferramentas de BI como Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Databricks, QlikView ou similares;
  • Programação: Capacidade em linguagens de programação como Python ou R, especialmente bibliotecas de análise de dados (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn) será um diferencial;

raw.description:
About Sharebite

Sharebite is the leading meal benefits platform built exclusively for companies to feed their employees. Our platform allows employees to order meals from any restaurant while streamlining all of the ordering & billing requirements for the company. Every meal ordered through the Sharebite platform results in a meal donation to local partners like City Harvest and Feeding America to help combat food insecurity. To date, Sharebite has donated over 15 million meals.

The Role

As a Senior Rev Ops / Salesforce Product Owner, you will be a key member of Sharebite’s Growth (Revenue) Operations team, responsible for the stability, scalability, and continuous improvement of our Salesforce platform and the analysis of data within to improve processes and increase ROI. This is a hands-on, business-facing role that combines day-to-day administration with ownership of data quality, process improvement, and internal projects.

You’ll partner closely with Operation and Growth teams. You will lead the initiative to help enforce best practices, maintain high data integrity, and ensure Salesforce remains a reliable and intuitive system for our users. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys operational ownership, problem-solving, and building scalable solutions.

User experience is critical to us. You should enjoy supporting users, designing thoughtful solutions, and translating evolving business needs into clean, maintainable Salesforce configurations.

What You’ll Do

This is a varied business facing role, with the following responsibilities:

  • Track KPI's of the Growth Team (i.e. quota attainment, pipeline coverage, etc.)

  • Analyze data and work with leadership to improve processes and increase ROI

  • Own the ongoing administration, upkeep, and optimization of Salesforce

  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and propose scalable solutions

  • Manage user access, licenses, roles, permissions, and security settings

  • Maintain ticketing workflows, prioritize requests, and help plan the Salesforce roadmap

  • Enforce data hygiene standards and perform regular quality checks

  • Configure and maintain Salesforce features including fields, page layouts, record types, automations, dashboards, and reports

  • Support internal projects in collaboration with other business teams and leadership

  • Provide end-user support, training, and documentation to improve adoption and satisfaction

  • Monitor and maintain the health of Salesforce integrations, partner with engineering and other teams on integration-related projects across connected systems, and develop a working understanding of AI and data tools to enrich, consolidate, and improve data quality for reporting and analysis.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience

  • Certified Salesforce Administrator (or actively pursuing)

  • 4+ years of hands-on Salesforce administration experience (SFDC)

  • Strong working knowledge of Salesforce configuration, security, and data model

  • Experience working with ticketing systems and project management tools

  • Understanding of Salesforce sharing and security (roles, profiles, permissions, OWD, sharing rules)

  • Experience implementing Salesforce configuration changes including (but not limited to): Workflow, Process Builder, fields, page layouts, record types, custom settings, dashboards, with a focus on flows, improving UX, reporting, and tracking revenue KPI's

  • Experience supporting Salesforce integrations and working with adjacent systems

  • Experience writing release notes & training guides for the team

  • Strong interest in developing data and AI skills to improve data quality, reporting, and operational insights.

At Sharebite, we are committed to providing competitive pay in line with industry and market standards. The base compensation range for this role is $110k - $125k per year, however actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, and location. Salary is just one component of Sharebite's total compensation package, which includes equity, multiple health insurance options, and a wide range of benefits, including a daily meal stipend.

At Sharebite, we're passionate about our mission to alleviate hunger and inspire employees to connect their work to a larger purpose. We know being well fed is an essential ingredient for employee wellbeing, team performance, and company culture - we've seen the results! Sharebite is proud to have been recognized as Inc. Magazine's Best in Business, Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators, and Inc 5000's Fastest Growing Companies.

Join our team and help bring do-good, feel-good eating to the world.

Du möchtest deine Expertise in einer innovativen und dynamischen Steuerberatungskanzlei einbringen, die Mandanten aus den unterschiedlichsten Branchen betreut? Bei uns, der SW Digital Tax, erhältst du die Möglichkeit, Mandanten sowohl in laufenden Steuerfragen als auch in komplexen Gestaltungsberatungen zu unterstützen.

Egal, ob du erfahren bist im Umgang mit nationalen oder internationalen Steuermandaten, bei uns kannst du dein Know-how voll ausschöpfen und weiter ausbauen. Werde Teil unseres Teams und profitiere von einem Arbeitsumfeld, das auf Vertrauen, Flexibilität und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung setzt.

Vorteile, auf die du dich freuen kannst:

  • Individuelle Entwicklung: Wir bieten dir maßgeschneiderte Weiterbildungen und Schulungen, damit du stets auf dem neuesten Stand der Steuerrechtsentwicklung bist. Unsere Karrierewege sind klar strukturiert und bieten dir zahlreiche Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten.
  • Attraktive Vergütung: Bei uns erwartet dich eine überdurchschnittliche Vergütung, die deinen Leistungen gerecht wird.
  • Breites Mandatenspektrum: Arbeite mit einer Vielzahl von Mandanten, von mittelständischen Unternehmen bis hin zu prominenten Persönlichkeiten, und entwickle steuerliche Strategien, die nachhaltig Erfolge sichern.
  • Moderne Arbeitsumgebung: Unsere Büroräume bieten dir eine angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre mit moderner technischer Ausstattung.

Deine täglichen Aufgaben:

Als Teil unseres Teams wirst du eigenverantwortlich die steuerliche und rechtliche Betreuung unserer Mandanten übernehmen. Deine Aufgaben umfassen unter anderem:

  • Gestaltungsberatung: Entwicklung und Umsetzung individueller steuerlicher Gestaltungskonzepte.
  • Laufende Steuerberatung: Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen, betrieblichen Steuererklärungen sowie die Beratung in steuerrechtlichen Fragestellungen.
  • Rechtsberatung: Abhängig von deiner Qualifikation, Betreuung und Beratung in rechtlichen Angelegenheiten, insbesondere im Steuerrecht.
  • Unterstützung bei Umstrukturierungen und M&A-Projekten: Begleitung und Beratung unserer Mandanten bei Unternehmensumwandlungen und anderen strategischen Entscheidungen.
  • Mandantenkommunikation: Direkter Kontakt zu unseren Mandanten zur Besprechung von steuerlichen und rechtlichen Themen sowie zur Entwicklung von Lösungen, die auf ihre individuellen Bedürfnisse zugeschnitten sind.

Eckdaten zur Stelle:

  • Gehalt: 70.000 bis 110.000 Euro (brutto) Jahresgehalt
  • Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: Vorhanden
  • Einarbeitungsphase: In der Regel 2–4 Monate

Interesse geweckt?

Wenn du Teil eines dynamischen und zukunftsorientierten Teams werden möchtest, dann bewirb dich jetzt! Sende deine Bewerbungsunterlagen unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins direkt per E-Mail an

kannst du dich auch auf unserer Webseite über weitere offene Stellen informieren und die passende Position für dich finden.

Dein SW Digital Tax Team

Requirements

  • Du bringst fundierte Fachkenntnisse im Steuerrecht mit und verfügst über einschlägige Berufserfahrung.
  • Der sichere Umgang mit DATEV-Programmen, insbesondere DATEV Unternehmen online, ist für dich selbstverständlich.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und bist teamorientiert.
  • Kommunikation ist eine deiner Stärken, und du hast Freude daran, deine Kenntnisse kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und an neuen Herausforderungen zu wachsen.

raw.description:
Vill du arbeta kliniskt med full flexibilitet och möjlighet att jobba hemifrån – samtidigt som du bidrar till att utveckla framtidens primärvård?

Doktor.se strävar efter att bli det självklara valet vid första vårdkontakt och arbetar för att göra primärvården tillgänglig för alla. Nu söker vi ytterligare läkare till vår digitala verksamhet.

Om rollen

Som läkare hos oss arbetar du med digitala patientmöten via chatt, telefon och video. Du möter patienter från hela Sverige och hanterar ett brett spektrum av primärvårdsärenden.

Arbetet innefattar bland annat:

  • Varierat mottagningsarbete via distanskonsultation

  • Bedömning och behandling av primärvårdsärenden

  • Rådgivning och hänvisning till rätt vårdnivå

  • Stöd till kollegor vid behov

Om dig

Vi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för primärvård och som trivs i ett digitalt arbetssätt. Du är kommunikativ, empatisk och trygg i din yrkesroll, med ett gott patientbemötande och hög medicinsk kvalitet i fokus. Vi kommer att prioritera kandidater som har möjlighet att arbeta eftermiddagar på vardagar samt helger.

Kvalifikationer:

  • Legitimerad läkare med minst två års erfarenhet från svensk primärvård efter avslutad BT/AT

  • Specialist- eller ST-läkare inom allmänmedicin är meriterande

  • Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift

  • God datorvana och bekväm med digitala verktyg

Om uppdraget

  • Konsultuppdrag via eget bolag

  • Arbete minimum 30 timmar per månad, gärna mer

  • Flexibla arbetstider

  • Möjlighet till dag-, kvälls- och helgarbete

  • Introduktion sker främst dagtid vardagar

  • Start enligt överenskommelse, gärna så snart som möjligt

Vad vi erbjuder

  • Flexibelt arbete – arbeta hemifrån eller remote (inom Sverige)

  • En innovativ och utvecklingsdriven arbetsplats

  • Möjlighet att bidra till och påverka framtidens digitala vård

  • Ett engagerat och kompetent team

  • Gedigen introduktion och kontinuerligt stöd

  • Tillgång till behandlingsriktlinjer, kollegialt stöd och modern plattform

  • Möjlighet till professionell och teknisk utveckling

Medicinsk kvalitet och stöd

Medicinsk kvalitet och patientsäkerhet är centralt i vår verksamhet. Du arbetar enligt tydliga riktlinjer och har alltid tillgång till stöd från kollegor och organisationen.

Vill du arbeta flexibelt och samtidigt göra skillnad?

Välkommen med din ansökan till Doktor.se – vi ser fram emot att ha dig med i vårt team!

Vi jobbar med löpande urval, så vänta inte med din ansökan utan skicka gärna in den redan idag – allt du behöver göra är att bifoga ditt CV och svara på några urvalsfrågor.

raw.description:
Help empower our global customers to connect to culture through their passions.

Why you’ll love this role:

StockX is the world’s leading marketplace for current culture, built at the intersection of commerce, community, and credibility. Sneakers are foundational to StockX — not just as a category, but as a culture, an economy, and a global community.

We are expanding how sneaker culture shows up on StockX through creator-driven, community-oriented commerce experiences that blend storytelling, expertise, and transaction. To do this well, we need category leaders who don’t just understand the sneaker market — they live inside it.

The Sneakers Category Manager is the single-threaded owner of sneaker category growth within a new, high-priority commerce initiative. This person is the in-house expert on sneaker culture, people, economics, and moments — and is responsible for translating that expertise into supply growth, engagement, and GMV.

You will act as:

  • The internal authority on the primary and secondary sneaker ecosystem
  • The external face of StockX to sneaker sellers, creators, and community leaders
  • The architect of the sneaker go-to-market / growth playbook for this new initiative

This role blends deep cultural fluency, strategic ownership, and hands-on execution. Early on, you will own everything related to sneakers within this initiative. As the category scales, you will grow into a leader overseeing a broader sneaker portfolio and team.

What You’ll Do:

Own the Sneakers Category End-to-End

  • Define and execute the growth strategy for sneakers within the platform
  • Own category-level performance across supply, engagement, and revenue
  • Establish quarterly goals, leading indicators, and operating rhythms

Be the Market & Culture Expert

  • Maintain deep, current knowledge of sneaker culture, including:
    • Key sellers, creators, collectors, and resellers
    • Sub-segments (hype vs. GRs, vintage, performance, regional markets, etc.)
    • Drops, releases, brand dynamics, and cultural moments
    • Pricing dynamics, liquidity, and resale economics
  • Serve as the internal voice of the sneaker community, informing product, marketing, and platform decisions

Supply & Creator Acquisition

  • Build and own a pipeline of high-impact sneaker sellers, shops, influencers, and creators
  • Personally recruit and onboard flagship sellers who set the tone for the platform
  • Develop seller strategies that balance credibility, storytelling, and commerce

Commerce Strategy & Category Moments

  • Identify and orchestrate sneaker-specific moments, campaigns, and formats that drive engagement and conversion
  • Partner with Category Marketing to design culturally authentic activations
  • Experiment with new approaches and iterate quickly based on performance and feedback

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Work closely with Account & Partnerships Managers to scale seller acquisition and support
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to shape features and tools that matter to sneaker sellers and buyers
  • Provide clear, actionable insights from the market to influence roadmap prioritization

Build the Playbook

  • Document learnings, frameworks, and best practices that can be reused across future categories
  • Help define what “great” looks like for category ownership at StockX
  • Support hiring and onboarding as the sneaker category team grows

About you:

  • Deeply embedded in sneaker culture — you know the people, platforms, trends, and economics, and you’re already plugged into the ecosystem
  • 5+ years of experience in category management, partnerships, marketplace growth, brand, or operator roles in sneakers, streetwear, or adjacent ecosystems
  • Comfortable owning outcomes, not just strategy — you execute, iterate, and adapt
  • Strong relationship builder with credibility among sellers, creators, and community members
  • Data-literate and commercially minded — you understand pricing, margins, liquidity, and incentives
  • Entrepreneurial, scrappy, and energized by building something from the ground up

Nice to Have:

  • Existing network of sneaker resellers, store owners, creators, or influencers
  • Experience buying and selling sneakers or operating within resale marketplaces
  • Familiarity with content-driven commerce, creator platforms, or enthusiast communities
  • Experience working cross-functionally with product and engineering teams

Why This Role Matters:

Sneakers will define the early perception and success of this new commerce initiative at StockX. This role sets:

  • The cultural bar for the platform
  • The go-to-market & growth blueprint for future categories
  • The credibility of StockX with the sneaker community

You will have outsized influence on how StockX expands its leadership from marketplace into deeper cultural engagement.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.
Pursuant to the Colorado Fair Pay Act, the base salary range in Colorado for this position is $120,000 to $130,000, plus opportunities for benefits (e.g., medical, dental), equity and discretionary bonuses. Compensation in other geographies may vary.

About StockX

StockX is proud to be a Detroit-based technology leader focused on the large and growing online market for sneakers, apparel, accessories, electronics, collectibles, trading cards, and more. StockX's powerful platform connects buyers and sellers of high-demand consumer goods from around the world using dynamic pricing mechanics. This approach affords access and market visibility powered by real-time data that empowers buyers and sellers to determine and transact based on market value. The StockX platform features hundreds of brands across verticals including Jordan Brand, adidas, Nike, Supreme, BAPE, Off-White, Louis Vuitton, Gucci; collectibles from brands including LEGO, KAWS, Bearbrick, and Pop Mart; and electronics from industry-leading manufacturers Sony, Microsoft, Meta, and Apple. Launched in 2016, StockX employs 1,000 people across offices and verification centers around the world. Learn more at www.stockx.com.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

The Customer Success Professional – Indirect is a customer and partner facing role assigned to our large and mid-market enterprise customer segment and aligned to our largest revenue sub-agents. Driving overall customer lifetime value with and through our partners. This role is accountable for the overall selling partner experience; creating an environment where it is easy to do business through Lumen, providing data-led insights to guide our partners actions and enabling adoption and utilization of digital tools.

Location

Due to the regional scope of this position, candidates must reside in Arizonia, California or Neveda to effectively support market activities, partner engagement, and customer-facing initiatives.

The Main Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain long-term, value-driven relationships with customers and partners to build trust and credibility
• Implement and manage customer and partner success plans aligned with business goals, ensuring value realization
• Collaborate cross-functionally with sales, delivery, and ecosystem partners to align on customer outcomes and solution expectations
• Orchestrate customer onboarding and lifecycle milestones using standardized journey templates for readiness and alignment
• Monitor and analyze customer and partner metrics (usage data, health indicators, financial metrics) to prioritize engagement and drive success
• Execute customer engagement strategies, including cadence calls, site visits, reviews, training, and digital touchpoints
• Drive product adoption and value realization by leveraging tools, accelerators, and feature communication
• Identify and qualify expansion opportunities within the portfolio, partnering with sales to support revenue growth
• Conduct regular business reviews with partners, assessing health, financial performance, and growth strategies
• Manage revenue retention, renewals, risk mitigation, and financial accountability across operations
• Communicate and escalate urgent customer concerns, coordinating mitigation plans and service improvement initiatives
• Facilitate internal knowledge sharing and action planning to continuously enhance customer and partner value

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • 4+ years customer success or account management experience
  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience
  • Experience in working with complex, multi-regional enterprise customers
  • Ability to effectively present, consult, and advise at various leadership levels
  • Assertive verbal and written communications skills with ability to build strategic relationships within organizations
  • Ability to work closely with the customer and effectively negotiate directly with the customer and internally on their behalf
  • Ability to interpret customer data points and insight while implementing customer engagement action plans

Native is a next-generation liquidity infrastructure that transforms traditional inventory-based trading with a credit-driven model. Powered by our Credit Margin Engine, Native ensures liquidity is available precisely when and where it’s needed, all through a single API. This creates a frictionless experience for DeFi participants, while seamlessly abstracting chain complexities for any ecosystem or dApp.

Position Summary

Native is seeking an experienced Senior Marketing Manager to join its growing team. In this leadership role, you will oversee and execute high-impact marketing strategies, including targeted content creation across social media channels, blogs, and marketing platforms. You will drive Native’s overall social media and marketing strategy, building a strong presence for both new and existing products across various business lines. This is an exciting opportunity to lead marketing initiatives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams such as product managers, engineers, and business users to address real-world challenges in the rapidly evolving DeFi space.

Job Responsibilities

  • Design and implement end-to-end marketing campaigns to drive hype, awareness, and adoption of new business product lines.

  • Stay up to date with the latest industry trends and best practices, identifying new opportunities to enhance platform engagement and expand to new channels.

  • Lead and oversee reporting on the growth and health of social media communities, using insights to refine strategies continually.

  • Develop and manage the content calendar across all marketing channels, ensuring alignment with overall business goals.

  • Define and execute a best-in-class approach to community engagement on various platforms.
    Cultivate a deep understanding of Web3 consumers and app developers to tailor marketing efforts effectively.

  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and marketing metrics across all channels, using data to inform decisions.

  • Create and oversee the production of engaging long-form and short-form content, including articles, presentations, narratives, social media posts, and other marketing assets.

  • Act as a strategic advisor to cross-functional teams, providing input on brand positioning and audience engagement tactics.

Job Requirements

  • 6-8 years of experience in content marketing, writing, and campaign management, with a proven track record of success on platforms such as Twitter, LinkedIn, and Reddit.

  • Demonstrated expertise in running high-impact growth marketing campaigns for technical audiences and end consumers.

  • Exceptional creativity and strong writing skills, including experience producing both fast-moving micro-content for social media and longer-form articles.

  • Advanced knowledge of DeFi, crypto, blockchain, and Web3 technologies, with the ability to translate technical concepts into engaging narratives.

  • Proven ability to lead and thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced start-up environment, adapting quickly to evolving priorities.

  • In-depth understanding of target audiences across multiple platforms, with the ability to engage them effectively in real-time.

  • Experience in content creation tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, and basic video editing software is a plus.

  • Strong analytical skills to track and interpret marketing performance metrics, driving data-driven decision-making.

  • Strong communication skills and fluent in English.

raw.title: Market Operations Director - MA
raw.excerpt: About Matter HealthMatter Health delivers primary and preventive healthcare directly to older adults living in affordable housing communities.
raw.description:
About Matter Health

Matter Health delivers primary and preventive healthcare directly to older adults living in affordable housing communities. Our mission is simple: to improve healthcare access by meeting patients where they are and building trusted relationships within the communities we serve. As we rapidly expand across the country, we are building a team of mission-driven professionals who thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments.

Total Healthcare. Where you live.

About the Role

Matter Health is seeking a Market Operations Director to lead the operational and financial performance of our Massachusetts market.

As the senior operational leader for the market, you will oversee execution across Matter Health’s buildings, care teams, community relationships, and payer partnerships. You will be accountable for market-level performance, including patient engagement, access, scheduling efficiency, staffing stability, capacity, productivity, and financial results.

This position operates in a dyad partnership with the Market Medical Director. The Market Medical Director owns clinical decisions, clinical quality, and patient safety, while the Market Operations Director owns operational and administrative execution. Together, both leaders share accountability for the performance of the market and the success of its care teams.

This is a highly visible, hands-on leadership position for someone who understands value-based care, can manage complex multisite healthcare operations, and knows how to translate business priorities into consistent execution. The ideal candidate brings strong operational and financial acumen, builds trusted relationships across organizational levels, and can lead teams successfully through growth and change.

Responsibilities

  • Own the financial and operational performance of Matter Health’s Massachusetts market

  • Manage market-level performance across patient engagement, access, scheduling efficiency, staffing stability, capacity, productivity, and execution KPIs

  • Lead the operational execution of integrated care teams composed of licensed clinicians and non-licensed team members

  • Partner with the Market Medical Director through a dyad leadership model to align clinical and operational priorities

  • Maintain clear accountability for operational decisions while respecting the Market Medical Director’s authority over clinical care, quality, and patient safety

  • Provide operational and administrative support to licensed clinical team members, including onboarding coordination, scheduling, leave coordination, workflow support, and non-clinical performance management

  • Lead workforce and capacity planning across the market

  • Ensure day-to-day staffing, scheduling, building access, and operational logistics support reliable care delivery

  • Partner with engagement and care-support teams to improve attributed-member engagement, first-visit completion, and longitudinal patient retention

  • Use operational, clinical, and financial data to identify performance gaps, prioritize opportunities, and develop corrective action plans

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with property managers, community organizations, and local stakeholders

  • Support market launches, operational expansion, and the implementation of new workflows and care-delivery capabilities

  • Establish clear performance expectations and accountability across market teams

  • Lead, coach, and develop employees across multiple roles and locations

  • Communicate organizational and operational changes clearly, comprehensively, and inclusively

  • Identify barriers to achieving market goals and ensure timely resolution

  • Build a collaborative, accountable, and mission-driven team culture

  • Model Matter Health’s values of Empathy, Trust, Tenacity, Teamwork, and Curiosity

Qualifications

  • Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse or Nurse Practitioner license

  • At least five years of experience in a director-level healthcare operations position or a role with comparable scope and responsibility

  • Demonstrated experience leading multisite, multi-clinic, or market-level healthcare operations

  • Direct P&L ownership or meaningful responsibility for the financial performance of a healthcare market, service line, or business unit

  • Experience operating within a value-based, risk-based, or payer-aligned healthcare model

  • Understanding of patient attribution, quality measures, payer dynamics, and the operational drivers of value-based performance

  • Experience leading multidisciplinary healthcare teams that include licensed and non-licensed employees

  • Experience managing staffing, scheduling, workforce capacity, productivity, and operational performance

  • Demonstrated ability to use data and performance metrics to identify barriers, establish priorities, and improve results

  • Strong leadership, communication, relationship-building, and conflict-resolution skills

  • Ability to collaborate effectively across clinical, operational, financial, and administrative functions

  • Ability to lead through rapid growth, organizational change, and ambiguity

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and systems used to monitor operational performance

  • Ability to work in a field-based environment and travel approximately 25%–50% throughout the assigned Massachusetts market

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience as an Operations Director, Practice Administrator, Market Leader, Market General Manager, or similar healthcare operations leader

  • Experience in primary care, Medicare Advantage, home-based care, community-based healthcare, or another value-based care organization

  • Experience working in a dyad, matrixed, or shared-accountability leadership model

  • Experience launching a new healthcare market, expanding multisite operations, or scaling a care-delivery model

  • Project-management experience

  • Experience working with property managers, community organizations, payers, or other external stakeholders

  • Experience supporting healthcare delivery within underserved communities

  • Experience leading operations in a rapidly growing or transforming healthcare organization

What Success Looks Like

  • Establishing reliable and accountable operations across Matter Health’s Massachusetts market

  • Achieving market-level financial, engagement, access, productivity, staffing, and execution goals

  • Improving attributed-member engagement, first-visit completion, and longitudinal patient retention

  • Building an effective dyad partnership with the Market Medical Director

  • Creating clear alignment between clinical and operational teams

  • Ensuring staffing, scheduling, capacity, and logistics consistently support care delivery

  • Identifying operational barriers early and implementing practical solutions

  • Building trusted relationships with employees, property managers, community organizations, payers, and other stakeholders

  • Leading successful market launches, operational expansion, and workflow implementation

  • Developing a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing market team

  • Balancing patient needs, employee experience, operational execution, and financial performance

Work Location

This is a field-based position supporting Matter Health’s Massachusetts market. The Market Operations Director will work across Matter Health locations, healthcare sites, affordable housing communities, and other market-based settings.

Candidates must be located within or able to regularly work throughout the assigned Georgia market.

Approximately 25%–50% travel within the market will be required based on operational, leadership, community, and care-delivery needs. Occasional travel to other Matter Health locations may also be required.

Why Matter Health

We believe where someone lives should never determine the healthcare they receive. Every team member at Matter Health plays an important role in expanding healthcare access for older adults living in affordable housing communities.

In this position, you will shape how Matter Health delivers care across the Massachusetts market. Your leadership will directly influence patient engagement, team performance, operational reliability, financial results, and our ability to build lasting relationships within the communities we serve.

If you are a collaborative and execution-focused healthcare operations leader who understands value-based care, enjoys building strong teams, and is energized by leading through growth and change, we want to meet you.

Total Healthcare. Where you live.

Working at Matter Health

Full-time team member benefits begin the first of the month following your start date.

Health & Wellness

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Employer-funded HSA options

  • Employer-paid life and disability insurance

  • Voluntary illness, accident, and hospitalization coverage

  • Access to Matter Health’s in-person and virtual care services

Financial Security

  • Competitive compensation

  • 401(k) with company match beginning at Day 60

  • Access to financial-wellness resources

Time Away

  • Up to four weeks of Paid Time Off

  • 10 paid company holidays

  • Two volunteer days annually

Equal Opportunity Employer

Matter Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences and are dedicated to creating an environment where every team member feels valued, respected, and supported.

Compensation Range: $185K - $190K

Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble!

Ensemble is a leading provider of technology-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end-to-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country.

Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference!

O.N.E Purpose:

  • Customer Obsession: Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.

  • Embracing New Ideas: Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation.

  • Striving for Excellence: Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results.

The Opportunity:

By embodying our core purpose of customer obsession, driving innovation, and delivering excellence, you will help ensure that every touchpoint is meaningful and contributes to our mission of redefining the possible in healthcare. The Director of Virtual Utilization Review will serve as a strategic leader focused on driving client partnerships, performance outcomes, and transformational change across people, process, and technology. This position emphasizes strategic oversight, data-driven decision-making, and relationship management rather than day-to-day workflow execution. You will lead complex, multi-client utilization review and utilization management operations while shaping the future of how we deliver value to our partners. This role will include travel, up to 25%.

Job Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Strategic Leadership & Client Partnership

  • Build strong, trusted relationships with clients and serve as a strategic partner
  • Develop a deep understanding of client KPIs and SLAs within the first 60 days
  • Identify and execute proactive opportunities to improve performance, satisfaction, and outcomes

Operational & Performance Excellence

  • Oversee complex multi-client utilization review and utilization management operations
  • Drive measurable improvements in performance, productivity, and SLA attainment
  • Lead data-driven decision-making using dashboards and analytics tools

Transformation & Change Management

  • Champion adoption of new technologies and investment capabilities
  • Lead large-scale change initiatives across people, process, and technology
  • Partner cross-functionally to implement process and system improvements

Team Leadership

  • Lead, develop, and mentor a large, multi-layered team of 125–175 employees globally
  • Manage and empower direct reports including a minimum of 3 leaders
  • Foster a high-performing culture aligned with organizational values

Who You’ll Work With

  • Direct reports and broader VUR organization
  • Clients and external partners
  • Cross-functional teams, including Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI)
  • Peer Directors and AVP-level leadership

What Makes This Role Exciting

  • Director-level strategic role with significant visibility and impact
  • Opportunity to lead a large, global team across multiple geographies
  • Exposure to complex healthcare operations in utilization review and management
  • Key role in driving technology transformation and innovation
  • Strong focus on analytics, performance improvement, and client experience

Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience

Working with Us
Challenging. Meaningful. Life-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day, in every department. From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. You’ll get the chance to grow and thrive through opportunities uncommon in scale and scope, alongside high-achieving teams. Take your career farther than you thought possible.

Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. Read more: .

Position Summary

The Global Talent Acquisition organization is seeking an experienced Executive Talent Sourcing & Pipeline Lead to support senior leadership roles at Bristol Myers Squibb. This role serves as a strategic partner to leaders, responsible for delivering executive talent aligned to current pipeline priorities while proactively building future‑ready leadership pipelines in support of succession and evolving capability needs. The ideal candidate brings strong business and scientific acumen, proven executive search expertise, and the ability to assess talent market trends, understand business strategy, and influence executive‑level decision‑making to ensure BMS attracts world‑class leaders who advance innovation and deliver meaningful impact for patients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and execute proactive sourcing strategies — mapping target companies, talent pools, and diverse leadership communities to anticipate future hiring needs
  • Identify, engage, and cultivate long-term relationships with passive executive talent through personalized outreach, networking, and thought-leadership engagement
  • Build and maintain robust, pipelines ensuring readiness for current searches and succession planning
  • Conduct deep market research and competitive intelligence — talent availability, compensation benchmarks, and competitor org structures
  • Partner with Recruiters and Hiring Leaders as a consultative advisor, calibrating strategy and presenting qualified, diverse slates
  • Develops future candidate pipelines and talent maps, determining the optimal job advertising mix, including job boards, careers pages and social networks and hiring pools to meet the organization's future needs.
  • Aggregates market and industry data for the purposes of negotiating compensation with applicants and influencing strategic recruiting methods with hiring teams.
  • Develops and maintains strong relationships with external partners including recruitment agencies, educational institutions, professional associations and industry networks, to expand talent pipelines and enhance the employer brand.
  • Ensures compliance with relevant labor laws, regulations and industry standards related to talent management, including equal employment opportunity (EEO), diversity and labor relations.
  • Serve as a Brand Ambassador for Bristol Myers Squibb, building trusted, long-term relationships with senior leaders and candidates
  • Ensure exceptional candidate and stakeholder experiences, while maintaining strict adherence to compliant recruiting and hiring practices in a highly regulated environment
  • Demonstrate the highest level of professionalism and discretion, engaging in industry forums to elevate BMS’s reputation as an employer of choice and bringing insights back into the organization for continuous improvement
  • Partner with Total Rewards, Global Mobility, Legal, Immigration, and Procurement to support executive offer development, negotiation, and delivery, while sharing market insights to inform competitive compensation strategies when applicable
  • Collaborate with non-executive recruiting teams to ensure transparency, talent sharing, and continuity across sourcing & recruiting efforts

Qualifications & Experience

  • 5-7 years of recruiting experience, with 3 years’ sourcing experience proactively generating candidates focused on senior-level recruiting. Experience in a Pharmaceutical/Biotech environment strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize ad hoc market intelligence data to provide information (talent market trend, threats, opportunity, etc.) to be used at business strategy level +
  • Expert level knowledge in candidate attraction and relationship building
  • Excellent at building and maintaining strong candidate pipelines
  • Expert level of knowledge of full life cycle recruiting activities including, but not limited to, sourcing, screening, and networking
  • Demonstrated ability to manage stakeholders at all levels of a highly matrixed organization and the ability to work across cross-functional, cross-organizational teams
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively partner and collaborate with colleagues in the Centers of Expertise and peers in People Services to deliver the most qualified talent for the company
  • Demonstrated ability to develop meaningful and trusted relationships with all levels of an organization
  • Strong understanding of technology and experience using talent acquisition systems, including Applicant Tracking, Candidate Relationship Management, social media, and other predictive tools
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate ideas and influence others to accomplish goals and objectives
  • Demonstrated ability to partner, manage and influence virtually
  • Demonstrated ability to work with outsource providers and contractors, if necessary

Minimum Requirements/Knowledge Desired:

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Consulting skills/ impact and influence abilities/ strong stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong analytical, problem-solving, interpersonal, planning and organizational skills

If you come across a role that intrigues you but doesn’t perfectly line up with your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. You could be one step away from work that will transform your life and career.

raw.description:
Docugami uses powerful artificial intelligence to unlock the information contained in highly varied, unstructured business documents. Business users, without IT or development projects, can immediately create custom analysis of vital document content and information from large batches of contracts, can assist users in creating new documents more efficiently and consistently, and can automatically connect information from within documents to other business systems.

Docugami started with years of R&D, and has received a $10M seed round of VC funding as well as multiple endorsements from industry leaders and publications. The founders are seasoned ex-Microsoft engineers and leaders, some already well known in the software industry for their record of building and running $1B+ innovative software product businesses.

Docugami recently established Docugami Europe and has chosen France to be the hub of the new Docugami Europe AI research lab. We are looking for an exceptional AI research scientist to lead the lab and manage an equally exceptional team of researchers and PhD interns. The goal of the Docugami Europe AI research lab is to continue to push our cutting-edge technology forward and collaborate with scientific institutions in France and Europe.

You will love this job if:

  • You want to work at the very cutting edge of artificial intelligence, multimodal machine learning, and natural language processing research
  • You love solving really challenging problems and seek opportunities to see your research deployed in practice to solve real world problems and impact millions of users
  • You are adept at communicating with a variety of stakeholders and audiences, including academics, team members, executives, and customers
  • You enjoy sharing the results of your research with others in a company and the wider scientific community via published papers, speaking opportunities, and team sessions
  • You have experience managing a team to perform to their best of their ability

What you’ll be responsible for:

  • Functioning as the head of the Docugami Europe AI research lab and leading a small team of researchers and scientists
  • Proposing solutions to the different science problems in an evolving environment
  • Leading collaboration with partners in academia and scientific institutions to stay at the very forefront of R&D in the industry
  • Collaborating with engineering and product leadership to plan and prioritize a long-term roadmap of science breakthroughs
  • Working with engineers who will be responsible for integrating and deploying your work in production
  • Sharing the results of the AI research lab through paper publications, conference engagements, and conducting regular internal science reviews and educational sessions for the Docugami team

What we look for in a candidate:

  • PhD (or equivalent experience) in areas like computer science, mathematics, statistics, electrical engineering, or related fields
  • More than 10 years of experience after completing PhD, or equivalent demonstrable industry experience
  • Deep and up-to-date experience with some of the following: generative artificial intelligence, natural language processing (NLP), machine translation, self-supervised learning, active learning, computer vision (CV), statistics, causal inference, and other related disciplines
  • Programming skills and familiarity of modern ML frameworks
  • Research track record demonstrated by top-level journal and conference publications
  • Strong leadership and problem-solving skills with direct management experience
  • Passion for technical and scientific excellence
  • Strong communication skills and capacity to report and disseminate results
  • Fluent in French and English and resides in France

Perks:

  • This position is located in France and will primarily be remote, with the ability to work from anywhere in France
  • Competitive salary with stock options
  • Healthcare plan
  • Competitive vacation and leave policy
  • Work closely with a cross-functional team of highly motivated folks with a unique range of startup, big enterprise, scientific, engineering, sales & marketing experience
  • Vibrant and inclusive company culture with frequent team-building events

About Us:

Docugami Europe is a subsidiary of Docugami, Inc. Docugami, Inc. (Docugami) is a Seattle-area document engineering startup that transforms how businesses create and manage documents for greater productivity, compliance, and insight using breakthrough artificial intelligence. Founded in March 2018 by former senior engineering leaders from Microsoft, Docugami harnesses a wide range of artificial intelligence techniques, including natural language processing, image recognition, declarative markup, and other approaches, to enable businesses of all sizes to radically improve how they create and manage documents for greater insight, efficiency, and business impact. Docugami Europe is headquartered in France.

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

Mission: Silvus is seeking a Bid Manager who will report to the International Customer Lifecycle Director. The successful individual in this role will be responsible for the coordination of the end-to-end bid process when responding to Requests for Quotation (RFQ) or tenders from customers or business partners in a timely fashion. Working with sales directors and projects teams, the bid manager will provide bid support for customer aligned proposals, making sound business judgement and maximising bid winning chance
with the goal to provide competitive offers while optimizing project cost and protecting margins. In addition, will review and monitor bid progress and resolve / escalate issues and problems to relevant stakeholders.

This position will be part of the International Customer Lifecycle team, working in a multi-cultural environment and supporting sales teams across EMEA, APAC and LATAM.

This position is eligible for 100% remote work depending on location.


Job Description

The following is a list of at least some of the current essential job functions of the position. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time at its discretion.

Key Responsibilities:

● Bid Process Management: Coordinate the end to end bid process. Manage an opportunity from qualification through to contract award, supporting the sales team with the bid strategy development, partner identification and value proposition.
● Virtual Team Management: Manage virtual bid teams and inputs from a variety of stakeholders.
● Cross Functional Interface: Interface with cross functional departments such as Sales, Engineering, Production, Bid & Quote, Product Group, Finance, Legal, Strategy, etc.
● Bid Environment Analysis: Understand the opportunities in terms of customer requirements, timing, costs, risks, features, competition and any other area impacting bid content and strategy.
● Market Knowledge: Excellent understanding of the market, company products and high sensitivity to competitive issues and tendering rules, to ensure consistency of the commercial proposal with the agreed bid strategy, financials and content as well as customer requirements fulfilment.
● Adherence to Business Practices: Maintain a good working knowledge of the company business practices and standards to ensure an appreciation of the broad scope of knowledge and content required to satisfactorily respond to tenders.
● Scope Management: Define Responsibility Matrix and Statement of Work for Organization and business partners.

● Planning: Create project implementation plans and cost projections.
● Proposal Management: Source and co-ordinate design input to ensure the visual standard of all documentation and presentation material is first class and eye-catching. Responsible for the quality of all aspects of the bid, including written documentation and presentations or demonstrations.
● Risk Management: including risk identification and mitigation action plan throughout the bid process.
● Bid Presentation: Present deliverables to management for informed bid decisions.
● Handover: Complete professional handover of successful bids to the Post-sale organization.


Basic Requirements

Candidate Profile:

● A self-motivated professional who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and takes full ownership of multitasking and shifting priorities.
● Languages: Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills. Fluency in English is mandatory.
● Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (preferably in communications, computer science, software or similar field).
● Experience:• + 5 years of Pre-sales bid experience, with proven track record of managing high-performing bid teams, preferably within theDefense, Aerospace, Robotics, or Semiconductor industries, with project management background including project cost, scope, schedule and risk analysis.
● Team Player: Team player with strong communication and commercial skills and ability to work under pressure to challenging deadlines.
● Communication: Strong leadership and communication skills. Comfortable working at CEO/Director level (internal and external customers).
● Working environment: Comfortable working for a dynamic, agile and technical organization with a rapidly expanding customer base.
● Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with the drone ecosystem (UAV regulations, flight controllers, propulsion systems) is a significant plus. Experience managing military or defense-sector clients is considered a significant asset.

All employment is contingent upon the successful clearance of a background check.

WORKING CONDITIONS &PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

● Office environment.

● Trade shows.

● Outdoor environment for occasional field demonstrations.

○ Lift equipment up to 20lbs. for the set-up of demonstrations and testing.
○ Manage the movement of large suitcase size Pelican cases (i.e. travel,
demos, etc.)

○ Extended periods of sitting.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

We are seeking a Senior eClinical Business Lead, IRT and DHT Design Consultant to join our team. As a strategic advisor in clinical technology, you will support clinical research activities that advance new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in RTSM and DHT study design, requirements analysis, stakeholder collaboration, and clinical trial optimization. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to study operations from planning through closeout. Responsibilities include providing expert consultation on digital health technology implementation, translating complex requirements into actionable solutions, and ensuring seamless integration across clinical trial systems.

You will join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through advancing clinical trial technology, improving study efficiency, and enhancing patient engagement. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, this role offers the chance to explore career paths and expand expertise across clinical research and digital health innovation.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide expert consultation to project leaders and study teams on RTSM and DHT study design, requirements gathering, and system configuration

  • Analyze protocols and collaborate with stakeholders to develop, review, and validate user requirements that align with study design objectives and regulatory standards

  • Identify, assess, and mitigate risks related to RTSM and DHT implementation, ensuring compliance with clinical trial processes and data integrity standards

  • Translate complex technical and business requirements into clear, actionable guidance for study teams and system users to facilitate informed decision-making

  • Evaluate system integrations and proactively identify potential issues with third-party interfaces, data flows, and user requirements to ensure seamless functionality

  • Partner with UAT leads to design, execute, and validate testing protocols, ensuring systems meet defined requirements and business objectives

  • Stay current on emerging RTSM and DHT technologies, industry best practices, and regulatory developments to drive continuous improvement and innovation

  • Manage quality assurance and timely delivery of project deliverables while implementing corrective actions to maintain excellence

  • Interact with external clients to discuss RTSM and DHT design considerations, protocol requirements, and implementation strategies

  • Demonstrate proactive problem-solving and deliver timely, effective solutions to client challenges and technical issues

You will thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Deep expertise in RTSM and DHT systems, clinical trial design, and requirements management

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with the capacity to work independently and escalate appropriately

  • Experience working in clinical research, healthcare, or a regulated environment

  • Exceptional ability to collaborate across teams and communicate complex concepts clearly to diverse audiences

  • Patient-focused mindset with strong attention to detail and commitment to data integrity

  • Comfortable working with RTSM platforms, digital health technology (DHT) solutions, and clinical trial management systems (CTMS).

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

  • 5+ years of experience in building RTSM and/or DHT clinical trial systems, developing user requirements, and managing requirements gathering, configuration, design, and user acceptance testing

  • Knowledge of ICH-GCP, regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes

  • Excellent technical and data standards knowledge with proven experience applying data standards in clinical trial environments

  • Demonstrated ability to create and explain business processes and train others on implementation

  • Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of industry standards such as CDISC SDTM and other data standards relevant to clinical trials

  • Experience with eCOA or ePRO systems and digital health technology platforms
